      - author_order
      - authorship_role

  FacilityAffiliation:
    is_a: Relationship
    description: >-
      A facility's affiliation with an organization, nested in a Facility so the facility is inferred from the containing record.
      Use one instance per hosting or owning organization in Facility.facility_affiliations and do not provide the containing facility's ID; joint labs get several.
    class_uri: cerif:Facility_OrganisationUnit
    slots:
      - organization
      - facility_affiliation_role

  EventAgentRole:
    is_a: Relationship
    description: >-
      A person or organization involved in the containing Event in a defined capacity, with optional dates when the involvement covers only part of a multi-day event or programme.
      Use in Event.event_agent_roles for organizers, hosts, speakers, panelists, participants or sponsors; do not use it merely because an agent authored a publication presented at the event.
    class_uri: schema:Role
    slots:
      - event_agent
      - event_agent_role

  ResourceContribution:
    is_a: Relationship
    description: >-
      A person or organization contributing to the containing Tool or Dataset in a defined capacity, with optional dates for time-bounded responsibility.
      Use in Tool.resource_contributions or Dataset.resource_contributions for creation, software development, maintenance, data curation or other named contributions; use publisher where supported for formal publication responsibility and Project.project_participations for project-level work.
    class_uri: schema:Role
    slots:
      - contributor
      - resource_contribution_role

  # ---- Container / tree root ---------------------------------------
  IndexContainer:
    tree_root: true
    description: >-
      Top-level holder for all IDHI records.
      Big entities live exactly once in these lists; everything else references them by their IDHI URN.
    attributes:
      persons:
        description: All Person records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Person
      organizations:
        description: All Organization records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Organization
      projects:
        description: All Project records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Project
      facilities:
        description: All Facility records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Facility
      tools:
        description: All Tool records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Tool
      services:
        description: All Service records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Service
      publications:
        description: All Publication records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Publication
      events:
        description: All Event records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Event
      datasets:
        description: All Dataset records in the index, including digital archives and catalogs.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Dataset
      training_materials:
        description: All TrainingMaterial records in the index, including tutorials, lessons and other didactic resources.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: TrainingMaterial

# ========================= SLOTS =====================================
slots:
  # --- identity / shared ---
  type:
    required: true
    range: curie
    description: Discriminator identifying the record's class; used for polymorphic serialization and deserialization.
    slot_uri: rdf:type
  id:
    identifier: true
    range: string
    description: >-
      The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form
        idhi:<class name>:<random short alphanumeric id>
      e.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1.
      Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed.
      The class token is the lowercase snake_case class name; each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage.
      External identifiers (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots — never here.
    slot_uri: dcterms:identifier
    pattern: "^idhi:[a-z_]+:[0-9a-z]{4,12}$"
  name:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    required: true
    description: >-
      The multilingual name or title used to identify the entity. Use one LangString per available language and do not repeat a language.
      Prefer the official localized name for organizations; for projects, tools and services, use localized names supplied by the team rather than translating branded names without authority.
    slot_uri: skos:prefLabel
  description:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index visitors, not internal notes).
    slot_uri: dcterms:description
  image:
    range: base64binary
    description: >-
      A representative image embedded as Base64-encoded binary content. Use for a single image that must travel with the entity record; omit it when no image is available, and use homepage or additional_urls for externally hosted pages rather than encoding a URL here.
    slot_uri: schema:image
  homepage:
    range: uri
    description: Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.
    slot_uri: foaf:homepage
  same_as:
    range: uri
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...).
      Use for linked-data alignment, not for the entity's own pages (use homepage).
    slot_uri: schema:sameAs
  tags:
    range: string
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Free-text tags for discovery, filtering and grouping; usable on any top-level entity.
      Deliberately NOT a controlled enum, but prefer wording that matches a concept in an established ontology or thesaurus (e.g. Wikidata, Getty AAT, TaDiRAH) so tags can later be reconciled against it.
    slot_uri: dcat:keyword
  additional_urls:
    range: uri
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Further relevant web pages beyond the homepage (blog, social-media profile, registry entry, press coverage...).
      For records describing the same entity in other systems use same_as instead.
    slot_uri: foaf:page
  contact_email:
    description: >-
      A published contact address for the entity (office, team or service-desk mailbox). For a person's own addresses use 'emails'.
    slot_uri: schema:email

  # --- LangString ---
  language:
    range: string
    required: true
    pattern: "^[A-Za-z]{1,8}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$"
    description: >-
      BCP-47 language tag of the value, such as en, he, ar, de, yi or lad. Use the shortest registered tag that accurately identifies the text; the deliberately permissive syntax guard accepts private and grandfathered tags and does not verify registration in the IANA language-subtag registry.
    slot_uri: dcterms:language
  value:
    range: string
    required: true
    description: A localized text, in the language given by 'language'.
    slot_uri: rdf:value

  # --- Person ---
  given_name:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    required: false
    description: Given (first) name as multilingual text. Use one LangString per available language with family_name when the person's name is conventionally expressed in separate parts; do not use it for a full name.
    slot_uri: foaf:givenName
  family_name:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    required: false
    description: Family (last) name as multilingual text. Use one LangString per available language with given_name when the person's name is conventionally expressed in separate parts; do not use it for a full name.
    slot_uri: foaf:familyName
  orcid:
    range: uri
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    description: >-
      The person's persistent researcher identifier.
      It supplements the IDHI record id.
      Strongly recommended for every researcher; enables deduplication and linking to the scholarly record.
    structured_pattern:
      syntax: "https://orcid.org/{orcid}"
      interpolated: true
  emails:
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Contact email addresses (zero or more). Only record addresses the person has agreed to publish in the index.
    slot_uri: foaf:mbox
  affiliations:
    range: Affiliation
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      The containing person's institutional affiliations, as reified Affiliation objects with organization, position and dates.
      Use for employment or formal membership, not for project involvement; the containing person's ID is inferred and must not be repeated in each relationship.
  project_participations:
    range: ProjectParticipation
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      People involved in the containing project, as reified ProjectParticipation objects carrying participant, role and dates.
      Define each participation only here on its Project; do not duplicate it on the Person.
  authorships:
    range: Authorship
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      People who contributed to the containing publication, as reified Authorship objects carrying author, byline order and role.
      Define each authorship only here on its Publication; do not duplicate it on the Person.

  # --- Organization ---
  ror:
    range: uri
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    description: >-
      The organization's persistent registry identifier.
      It supplements the IDHI record id.
      Record it whenever the organization is registered in ROR — most universities and research institutes are.
    structured_pattern:
      syntax: "https://ror.org/{ror}"
      interpolated: true
  organization_type:
    range: OrganizationTypeEnum
    description: >-
      The kind of organization. Always set it.
    slot_uri: dcterms:type
  organization_structure:
    range: OrganizationStructure
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Formal parent relationships of the containing organization, with the parent and optional start and end dates.
      Define each containment relationship only on the child organization; use organization_roles for project partnerships and omit this slot for informal associations. This uses an IDHI-specific property because established parent-organization properties point directly to the parent and cannot carry relationship dates.
    slot_uri: idhi:organizationStructure
  marketplace_sync:
    range: boolean
    description: >-
      Opt-in flag for synchronization with the DARIAH SSH Open Marketplace. Set true to allow the organization and entities related to it through IDHI references, such as services and tools, to be synchronized; false or omission means they must not be synchronized on this organization's authority.
      This operational flag does not assert ownership of related entities. It uses an IDHI-specific property because established descriptive vocabularies do not provide a term for this synchronization policy.
    slot_uri: idhi:marketplaceSync
  location:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Place name where the organization, facility or event is physically situated (e.g. a city), as free multilingual text.
    slot_uri: schema:location

  # --- Facility ---
  facility_affiliations:
    range: FacilityAffiliation
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      The organizations hosting or owning the containing facility, as reified FacilityAffiliation objects with a required relationship role and optional dates.
      Reference each organization and infer the facility from its containing record; define separate relationships if different organizations host and own the facility.
  services_offered:
    range: Service
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Services this facility offers to researchers.
      Reference Service records by id; the Service's own 'provider' may still point at the parent Organization.
  tools_provided:
    range: Tool
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Tools this facility maintains or gives access to (by id).
      Use for hosted instances and lab-maintained software, not for every tool staff members happen to use.

  # --- Project ---
  digital_humanities_activities:
    range: DigitalHumanitiesActivityEnum
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Digital-humanities research activities practiced in this project, tool or service, or taught by this training material.
      Prefer the most specific applicable activity; multiple values are expected.
      This is the primary DH-facet for discovery.
    slot_uri: dcterms:subject
  research_disciplines:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Humanities discipline(s) of the project (history, linguistics, archaeology...).
      Free multilingual text for now; a controlled vocabulary is a planned upgrade.
    slot_uri: dcterms:subject
  studied_periods:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Historical period(s) the project studies (e.g. Ottoman period), as free multilingual labels — distinct from the project's own start_date/end_date.
    slot_uri: dcterms:temporal
  studied_places:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Geographic focus of the research (places studied), as free multilingual labels — distinct from where the project team sits.
    slot_uri: dcterms:spatial
  organization_roles:
    range: OrganizationProjectRole
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Organizations engaged in the containing project, as reified OrganizationProjectRole objects carrying a coordinator, partner, data provider, funder or host role.
      Reference each organization and infer the project from its containing record; use FUNDER only when no distinct award can be represented in funding.
  uses_tools:
    range: Tool
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Tools used to conduct the containing project (by IDHI URN).
      Use for substantive research or technical dependencies, not tools produced by the project, which belong in outputs_tools.
    slot_uri: schema:instrument
  uses_services:
    range: Service
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Services used by the containing project (by IDHI URN).
      Use for externally or institutionally delivered services that support the work, not services produced as project outputs.
    slot_uri: dcterms:requires
  uses_datasets:
    range: Dataset
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Existing datasets used as research inputs by the containing project (by IDHI URN).
      Use for source or reference data consumed by the project, not datasets produced by it, which belong in outputs_datasets.
    slot_uri: prov:used
  outputs_tools:
    range: Tool
    multivalued: true
    description: Tools produced by this project (by id).
    slot_uri: schema:producer
  outputs_datasets:
    range: Dataset
    multivalued: true
    description: Datasets produced or curated by this project (by id).
  outputs_publications:
    range: Publication
    multivalued: true
    description: Publications resulting from this project (by id).
  outputs_training_materials:
    range: TrainingMaterial
    multivalued: true
    description: Training materials produced by this project (by IDHI URN); use only for project outputs, not materials merely used by the project.
    slot_uri: dcterms:relation
  funding:
    range: Funding
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Funding awards received by the project. Use one entry per distinct award, including successive awards from the same organization, and record award dates here rather than duplicating the same fact as a FUNDER organization role.
  funding_status:
    range: FundingStatusEnum
    description: >-
      The project's current primary funding or sustainability status at the time the record is maintained. Use this for present support, while funding records preserve past and current award history; update it when the project's circumstances change. This uses an IDHI-specific property because established vocabularies do not provide a controlled current-sustainability status for projects.
    slot_uri: idhi:fundingStatus
  funding_organization:
    range: Organization
    required: true
    description: The organization that provides this funding award (by IDHI URN).
    slot_uri: schema:funder
  funding_amount:
    range: float
    description: >-
      Amount awarded by the funding organization, if public, in the currency given by funding_currency, or ILS when no currency is recorded. Omit rather than guess.
    slot_uri: frapo:hasMonetaryValue
  funding_currency:
    range: CurrencyEnum
    description: >-
      Currency of funding_amount. Record it whenever the amount is present and the currency is known; omit it when no amount is recorded.
    slot_uri: schema:currency
  grant_name:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Official multilingual title of the individual grant or award. Use this for the award's title, not the broader recurring programme, which belongs in funding_program.
    slot_uri: schema:name
  funding_program:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Multilingual name of the broader funding programme or scheme under which the award was made. This uses an IDHI-specific property because FRAPO defines FundingProgramme as a class but has no fitting property for a literal programme label.
    slot_uri: idhi:fundingProgram
  grant_number:
    range: string
    description: >-
      Identifier assigned to the grant by its funding organization. Use the funder's exact value and omit it when none is published.
    slot_uri: frapo:hasGrantNumber
  funding_url:
    range: uri
    description: >-
      Public landing page for the individual award or its authoritative funding record. Use the funding organization's homepage on the Organization record instead when no award-specific page exists.
    slot_uri: schema:url

  # --- Tool ---
  tool_type:
    range: ToolServiceTypeEnum
    description: >-
      The delivery form of the tool (web app, library, CLI...). Pick the single value describing how users primarily consume it.
    slot_uri: schema:applicationCategory
  code_repository:
    range: uri
    description: Source-code repository URL (GitHub, GitLab...), if open.
    slot_uri: schema:codeRepository
  programming_language:
    range: string
    description: Main implementation language, as a single technical label such as Python. Do not use this slot for natural languages supported by the tool.
    slot_uri: schema:programmingLanguage
  license:
    range: LicenseEnum
    description: >-
      The license under which the tool, dataset or training material is released. Required for anything advertised as reusable; omit only if genuinely unknown.
    slot_uri: dcterms:license
  documentation_url:
    range: uri
    description: >-
      User or developer documentation for the tool or service (manual, wiki, API reference).
    slot_uri: schema:softwareHelp

  resource_contributions:
    range: ResourceContribution
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Named contributions to the containing Tool or Dataset, with contributor, role and optional dates.
      Define each contribution only on the resource; use publisher where supported for the organization formally releasing it and Project.project_participations for work described only at project level.
    slot_uri: dcterms:contributor

  # --- Service ---
  service_type:
    range: ToolServiceTypeEnum
    description: The kind of service offered (digitization, consulting...).
    slot_uri: schema:serviceType
  provider:
    range: Organization
    description: >-
      The organization formally responsible for delivering the service (the one you'd contact or contract with) — set this even when the service is listed under a Facility.
    slot_uri: schema:provider

  # --- Publication ---
  doi:
    range: uri
    slot_uri: bibo:doi
    description: >-
      The publication, dataset, tool or training material's DOI persistent identifier. Record it whenever one exists; it is the preferred deduplication key and is supplementary to the IDHI URN.
    structured_pattern:
      syntax: "https://doi.org/{doi}"
      interpolated: true
  publication_type:
    range: PublicationTypeEnum
    description: >-
      The kind of publication (journal article, book part, conference paper, thesis...). Pick the most specific applicable value.
    slot_uri: dcterms:type
  date_issued:
    range: date
    description: Formal publication date (or year-01-01 if only the year is known).
    slot_uri: dcterms:issued
  published_in:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Name of the journal, book or proceedings the publication appeared in, as free multilingual text. If the container work has its own IDHI record or external URI, also link it via part_of.
    slot_uri: schema:isPartOf
  presented_at:
    range: Event
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Event(s) in the index where this publication was presented (by IDHI URN), e.g. the conference where the paper was given. Distinct from published_in, the container it appeared in.
    slot_uri: bibo:presentedAt
  part_of:
    range: uriorcurie
    description: >-
      The containing work (book for a chapter, proceedings for a paper), by IDHI URN or external URI.
    slot_uri: dcterms:isPartOf

  # --- Event ---
  event_type:
    range: EventTypeEnum
    description: The kind of scholarly event.
    slot_uri: dcterms:type
  event_agent_roles:
    range: EventAgentRole
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      People and organizations involved in the containing event, with their role and optional relationship dates.
      Define each involvement only on the Event; use Publication.authorships for authorship and presented_at for the event at which a publication was presented.
    slot_uri: schema:participant
  start_date:
    range: date
    description: >-
      Start of the event, of the project's runtime, or of a relationship's validity, such as when participation, affiliation, maintenance responsibility or formal containment began.
    slot_uri: schema:startDate
  end_date:
    range: date
    description: >-
      End of the event, project runtime or relationship. Omit for ongoing relationships and open-ended projects.
    slot_uri: schema:endDate

  address:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: Postal address, multilingual.
    slot_uri: schema:address

  # --- Dataset ---
  datasets:
    range: Dataset
    multivalued: true
    description: Datasets aggregated by a Dataset that functions as a catalog (by id).
    slot_uri: dcat:dataset
  dataset_type:
    range: DatasetTypeEnum
    description: >-
      The dataset's primary intellectual or collection form. Use this for discovery categories such as digital edition, corpus or gazetteer; use media_type for its technical serialization.
    slot_uri: dcterms:type
  derived_from:
    range: Dataset
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Source datasets from which this dataset was re-OCRed, cleaned, transformed, subsetted or otherwise derived. Reference each immediate source by IDHI URN; use datasets only for catalog aggregation rather than provenance.
    slot_uri: prov:wasDerivedFrom
  publisher:
    range: Organization
    description: The organization formally publishing the dataset, publication or training material (by IDHI URN); use creators for responsibility for making a training material.
    slot_uri: dcterms:publisher
  themes:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: Thematic keywords for the dataset, multilingual.
    slot_uri: dcat:theme
  distribution_url:
    range: uri
    description: Direct download or access URL for the dataset.
    slot_uri: dcat:downloadURL
  extent:
    range: string
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Technical extent statements such as record, item, issue, image or file counts. Use one concise statement per measure, include its unit, and use byte_size rather than prose for total bytes.
    slot_uri: dcterms:extent
  byte_size:
    range: integer
    description: >-
      Total size of the described dataset distribution in bytes. Use an exact or documented aggregate byte count and omit it when only an unreliable estimate is available.
    slot_uri: dcat:byteSize
  related_publications:
    range: Publication
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Publications that are counterparts or direct scholarly companions of the dataset, such as the print counterpart of a digital edition. Reference Publication records by IDHI URN; use outputs_publications on Project for outputs that are related only by their project of origin.
    slot_uri: dcterms:relation

  training_material_type:
    range: TrainingMaterialTypeEnum
    description: >-
      The material's primary didactic form. Choose the single value that best describes how learners engage with it, not its file format.
    slot_uri: schema:learningResourceType
  creators:
    range: Agent
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      People or organizations responsible for creating the training material (by IDHI URN). Use publisher for the organization that formally releases it when that differs from its creators.
    slot_uri: dcterms:creator
  learning_outcomes:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Knowledge or skills a learner should gain by completing the material, as multilingual statements. Use one entry per distinct outcome; do not use this for prerequisites.
    slot_uri: schema:teaches
  target_audiences:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Intended learner groups, as multilingual labels such as researchers, librarians or students. Use educational_level separately for the expected level of study or expertise.
    slot_uri: dcterms:audience
  prerequisites:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Knowledge, skills, software or prior material learners should have before starting, expressed as multilingual text. Omit when no prerequisites apply.
    slot_uri: schema:coursePrerequisites
  educational_level:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Expected learner level, as multilingual text such as beginner, intermediate or graduate. Use target_audiences for who the material serves rather than their proficiency.
    slot_uri: schema:educationalLevel
  in_languages:
    range: string
    multivalued: true
    pattern: "^[A-Za-z]{1,8}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$"
    description: >-
      Languages substantially represented in a dataset or in which instructional content is available, using BCP-47 tags. For training material, record every complete language version and do not include a language used only in captions or examples; for datasets, record the languages of the data rather than its metadata page.
    slot_uri: dcterms:language
  material_url:
    range: uri
    description: >-
      Direct landing or access URL for the instructional resource. Use homepage for a broader site about the material and material_url for the resource learners open.
    slot_uri: schema:url
  media_type:
    range: string
    description: >-
      Technical media type of the primary dataset distribution or training resource, preferably an IANA media type such as text/html, application/pdf, application/vnd.apache.parquet or video/mp4. Dataset records may list multiple formats; do not use this for an intellectual or didactic form, which belongs in dataset_type or training_material_type.
    slot_uri: dcterms:format
  related_tools:
    range: Tool
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Tools whose use the material teaches or demonstrates (by IDHI URN). Do not use this merely for software used to produce the material.
    slot_uri: schema:about
  related_services:
    range: Service
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Services that the material explains how to access or use (by IDHI URN). Do not use this for the organization publishing the material.
    slot_uri: schema:about
  related_datasets:
    range: Dataset
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Datasets used as the subject or worked example of the material (by IDHI URN). Do not use this for incidental source data that learners never encounter.
    slot_uri: schema:about
  part_of_training_material:
    range: TrainingMaterial
    description: >-
      The larger training material of which this resource is a module or lesson (by IDHI URN). Use only for formal instructional containment, not loose topical similarity.
    slot_uri: dcterms:isPartOf

  # --- Relationship endpoints & roles --------------------------------
  participant:
    range: Person
    required: true
    description: The person taking part in the containing project (by IDHI URN). Use in Project.project_participations; do not define the relationship on the Person.
  parent_organization:
    range: Organization
    required: true
    description: The larger organization containing the current child organization (by IDHI URN). Use only in Organization.organization_structure; define the relationship on the child rather than the parent.
    slot_uri: schema:parentOrganization
  participation_role:
    range: ProjectRoleEnum
    description: >-
      The person's function within the project team.
      Use PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR only for the formally designated PI(s); DH_LEAD for digital method and architecture, TECHNICAL_LEAD for ownership of software engineering, DEVELOPER for implementation, CONSULTANT for bounded external professional work, RESEARCHER for scholarly research, STUDENT for enrolled students, ADVISOR for mentorship, and CONTRIBUTOR only when none of the specific values fits.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  organization:
    range: Organization
    required: true
    description: The organization referenced by a person affiliation, facility affiliation or project role (by IDHI URN). The Person, Facility or Project containing the relationship supplies its other endpoint.
  facility_affiliation_role:
    range: FacilityAffiliationRoleEnum
    required: true
    description: >-
      The organization's relationship to the containing facility.
      Use HOST when it provides the facility's institutional or operational home and OWNER when it legally or administratively owns the facility; create two relationships when distinct organizations fill those roles.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  affiliation_role:
    range: PersonOrgRoleEnum
    description: >-
      The person's position at the organization (their job/status, not their project role).
      Use EMPLOYEE when no finer value fits; AFFILIATE is for formal association without employment.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  org_project_role:
    range: OrgProjectRoleEnum
    description: >-
      The organization's function in the project: COORDINATOR leads the consortium, PARTNER contributes work, DATA_PROVIDER supplies source data, FUNDER records funding when no distinct award can be described, and HOST provides the institutional home.
      Create one relationship instance per role, and do not duplicate an award already represented in funding.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  author:
    range: Person
    required: true
    description: The person contributing to the containing publication (by IDHI URN). Use in Publication.authorships; do not define the relationship on the Person.
  author_order:
    range: integer
    description: Position in the byline; 1 = first author.
    slot_uri: schema:position
  authorship_role:
    range: AuthorshipRoleEnum
    description: >-
      The kind of contribution.
      AUTHOR is the default for byline authors; use EDITOR/TRANSLATOR for edited volumes and translations; CONTRIBUTOR for named non-byline contributions.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  event_agent:
    range: Agent
    required: true
    description: The person or organization involved in the containing event (by IDHI URN). Use only in Event.event_agent_roles; do not duplicate the relationship on the Agent.
    slot_uri: schema:agent
  event_agent_role:
    range: EventAgentRoleEnum
    required: true
    description: >-
      The capacity in which the agent is involved in the containing event.
      Choose the most specific applicable role and create separate relationships when the same agent has multiple roles.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  contributor:
    range: Agent
    required: true
    description: The person or organization contributing to the containing Tool or Dataset (by IDHI URN). Use only in resource_contributions; do not duplicate the relationship on the Agent.
    slot_uri: dcterms:contributor
  resource_contribution_role:
    range: ResourceContributionRoleEnum
    required: true
    description: >-
      The contributor's responsibility for the containing Tool or Dataset.
      Choose the most specific applicable role and create separate relationships when one contributor has materially distinct responsibilities.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
# ========================= ENUMS =====================================
enums:
  # ------------------------ DYNAMIC ENUMS ---------------------------
  DigitalHumanitiesActivityEnum:
    description: >-
      Digital-humanities research activities: Analyzing, Capturing, Creating, Disseminating, Enriching, Interpreting, Storing, and their more specific subactivities.
    annotations:
      source_url: https://vocabs.dariah.eu/rest/v1/tadirah/data?format=text/turtle
      source_format: turtle
    reachable_from:
      source_ontology: https://vocabs.dariah.eu/tadirah/
      source_nodes:
        - tadirah:analyzing
        - tadirah:capturing
        - tadirah:creating
        - tadirah:disseminating
        - tadirah:enriching
        - tadirah:interpreting
        - tadirah:storing
      include_self: true
      relationship_types:
        - skos:narrower

  PublicationTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      The kind of publication, including journal article, book part, conference paper and thesis.
    annotations:
      source_url: https://vocabularies.coar-repositories.org/resource_types/resource_types.nt
      source_format: n-triples
    matches:
      source_ontology: http://purl.org/coar/resource_type/
      identifier_pattern: "^http://purl\\.org/coar/resource_type/.+$"

  # ------------------------ STATIC ENUMS ----------------------------
  # Small, IDHI-governed vocabularies are kept static on purpose:
  # dynamic enums pay off for large external taxonomies, not for a handful of locally-controlled values.
  # Where an external concept exists (schema.org, CRediT, SPDX), `meaning:` records it.

  OrganizationTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      Kinds of organization. Canonical discriminator for Organization; pick the value matching the organization's PRIMARY nature.
    permissible_values:
      ACADEMIC_INSTITUTION:
        description: A degree-granting university or college.
        meaning: schema:CollegeOrUniversity
      GLAM_INSTITUTION:
        description: A gallery, library, archive or museum.
      RESEARCH_CENTER:
        description: >-
          A research center or institute, whether independent or within a university; when it is structurally contained in another organization, also add organization_structure with that parent and any known dates.
        meaning: schema:ResearchOrganization
      FUNDER:
        description: A body whose primary role is funding research.
        meaning: schema:FundingScheme
      COMPANY:
        description: A commercial company.
        meaning: schema:Corporation
      NON_PROFIT:
        description: A non-profit organization / NGO.
        meaning: schema:NGO
      INFORMAL_GROUP:
        description: >-
          A named collective without formal incorporation or institutional status. Use this only when the collective itself needs an Organization record; represent independent practitioners as Person records, and leave a project host-less when no organization hosts it. No established organization-type term captures this distinction closely enough for an external meaning.

  ProjectRoleEnum:
    description: >-
      A person's role in a project. Where a CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) concept approximates the role, `meaning:` records it.
    permissible_values:
      PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR:
        description: The formally designated lead researcher (PI).
      CO_PI:
        description: A formally designated co-principal investigator.
      RESEARCHER:
        description: A team member conducting the scholarly research.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/investigation/
      DH_LEAD:
        description: >-
          Leads the project's digital-humanities method, data model, research pipeline or digital-edition architecture. Use this for intellectual leadership of the digital approach, distinct from the formal PI and from software implementation.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/methodology/
      TECHNICAL_LEAD:
        description: >-
          Owns or directs the project's software engineering and technical maintenance. Use this when responsibility exceeds implementation by a DEVELOPER; use DH_LEAD instead for leadership of the scholarly digital method or data model.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/software/
      DEVELOPER:
        description: A team member implementing the project's software under their own or another person's technical direction; use TECHNICAL_LEAD when they own the engineering architecture and maintenance.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/software/
      STUDENT:
        description: >-
          An enrolled student (BA/MA/PhD) working on the project in any capacity — student status takes precedence over task.
      ADVISOR:
        description: An external mentor or advisory-board member providing ongoing guidance; use CONSULTANT for bounded professional work with a defined deliverable.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/supervision/
      CONSULTANT:
        description: >-
          An external specialist engaged for bounded professional work, such as designing an initial data model. Use ADVISOR for mentorship or board guidance and CONTRIBUTOR only when the work cannot be described more specifically; no established CRediT role exactly matches consultancy.
      CONTRIBUTOR:
        description: Fallback for any other named involvement.

  PersonOrgRoleEnum:
    description: A person's position within an organization (job/status).
    permissible_values:
      PROFESSOR:
        description: Faculty member of any professorial rank.
      ASSOCIATE:
        description: Research associate / postdoc.
      MEMBER:
        description: Formal member of a center, lab or society.
      MANAGER:
        description: Administrative or lab manager.
      AFFILIATE:
        description: Formal association without employment.
      EMPLOYEE:
        description: Staff fallback when no finer value fits.

  FacilityAffiliationRoleEnum:
    description: >-
      IDHI-governed roles distinguishing the organizations connected to a facility. Use one relationship per organization and role so hosting and ownership are not conflated.
    permissible_values:
      HOST:
        description: The organization provides the facility's institutional or operational home; use OWNER instead when only legal or administrative ownership is asserted. No established controlled concept precisely captures this facility-host role.
      OWNER:
        description: The organization legally or administratively owns the facility; use HOST instead when it operates or houses a facility it does not own.
        meaning: schema:owns

  OrgProjectRoleEnum:
    description: An organization's role in a project (one instance per role).
    permissible_values:
      COORDINATOR:
        description: Leads/coordinates the project or consortium.
      PARTNER:
        description: Contributes work as a consortium member.
      DATA_PROVIDER:
        description: Supplies a source collection or data used by the project without thereby acting as its host, coordinator or funder.
        meaning: schema:provider
      FUNDER:
        description: Provides funding for the project when no distinct award can be described; use Funding instead when grant metadata or award dates are known, and do not use both for the same funding fact.
      HOST:
        description: Provides the institutional/administrative home.

  EventAgentRoleEnum:
    description: >-
      IDHI-governed roles for people and organizations involved in events. Choose the most specific role and use separate EventAgentRole instances for multiple capacities.
    permissible_values:
      ORGANIZER:
        description: Plans or administers the event; use HOST for the institution providing the venue or institutional home.
        meaning: schema:organizer
      HOST:
        description: Provides the event's venue or institutional home without necessarily organizing its programme. No established controlled concept precisely distinguishes this role from organizer.
      SPEAKER:
        description: Delivers a lecture, presentation or other individual spoken contribution; use PANELIST for participation in a panel discussion.
      PANELIST:
        description: Participates as a named member of a panel; use SPEAKER for a standalone talk and PARTICIPANT for another active capacity.
      PARTICIPANT:
        description: Takes an active named part in the event when no more specific organizer, host, speaker or panelist role applies; do not use for unrecorded general attendance.
        meaning: schema:attendee
      SPONSOR:
        description: Provides financial or material sponsorship for the event; use ORGANIZER when the same agent also administers the event.
        meaning: schema:sponsor

  ResourceContributionRoleEnum:
    description: >-
      Roles for named contributions to tools and datasets. Use the most specific responsibility and record separate contributions when one agent holds multiple materially different roles.
    permissible_values:
      CREATOR:
        description: Originates the resource as a whole; use DEVELOPER for software implementation and DATA_CURATOR for stewardship of dataset contents.
        meaning: dcterms:creator
      DEVELOPER:
        description: Designs or implements software in a Tool; do not use for dataset curation or for project-level participation without a specific resource contribution.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/software/
      MAINTAINER:
        description: Holds ongoing technical or operational responsibility for the resource after its creation; use DEVELOPER for implementation work without continuing maintenance responsibility.
        meaning: schema:maintainer
      DATA_CURATOR:
        description: Manages, cleans, annotates, preserves or documents the contents of a Dataset; use CREATOR for originating the resource as a whole.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/data-curation/
      CONTRIBUTOR:
        description: Makes a named contribution that does not fit creator, developer, maintainer or data curator; use only after the more specific roles have been considered.
        meaning: dcterms:contributor

  FundingStatusEnum:
    description: >-
      IDHI-governed values for the current primary way a project is financially or operationally sustained; no established controlled vocabulary covers these project-maintenance states. Historical grants belong in Funding records; choose the value that best describes the project's present circumstances.
    permissible_values:
      ACTIVE_GRANT_FUNDING:
        description: A current time-bounded grant or award is the project's primary support; use INSTITUTIONALLY_SUSTAINED for ongoing core institutional support.
      INSTITUTIONALLY_SUSTAINED:
        description: An organization sustains the project through ongoing core resources rather than a distinct active grant; use IN_KIND_ONLY when support is limited to contributed facilities, staff time or services.
      IN_KIND_ONLY:
        description: The project currently receives non-cash support such as facilities, hosting, staff time or services but no direct funding; use VOLUNTEER_RUN when unpaid individual labor is the primary support.
      VOLUNTEER_RUN:
        description: The project is currently developed or maintained primarily through unpaid individual labor; past seed grants should still be recorded separately in funding.
      UNFUNDED:
        description: The project currently has neither direct funding nor material institutional, in-kind or volunteer support; do not use this merely because a past grant has ended if active maintenance continues under another model.

  CurrencyEnum:
    description: >-
      Currencies in which a funding award amount may be expressed, as ISO 4217 codes. The list covers the currencies relevant to IDHI records; extend it before recording an award in another currency.
    permissible_values:
      ILS:
        description: Israeli new shekel, the default currency for awards from Israeli funders when none is stated.
        meaning: http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q131309
      USD:
        description: United States dollar; use for awards denominated in dollars, not for converted approximations of another currency.
        meaning: http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4917
      EUR:
        description: Euro; use for awards denominated in euros, such as European Union programme grants, not for converted approximations of another currency.
        meaning: http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4916

  DatasetTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      IDHI-governed discovery categories for datasets and dataset-like intellectual objects. Choose the primary form and use tags for secondary characteristics.
    permissible_values:
      DIGITAL_EDITION:
        description: A scholarly or documentary edition whose edited texts, apparatus or aligned versions are delivered digitally; use CORPUS for a collection intended primarily for analysis rather than editorial presentation.
      CORPUS:
        description: A curated collection of texts, images, recordings or records assembled primarily for research or computational analysis; use IMAGE_COLLECTION when images are the defining intellectual form.
      DATABASE:
        description: Structured records designed primarily for querying and ongoing data management; use GAZETTEER for place-centered authority data and METADATA_CATALOG for records describing other resources.
      GAZETTEER:
        description: Structured place-name or geographic authority data connecting names, places and often historical attestations; use DATABASE for non-geographic structured data.
      IMAGE_COLLECTION:
        description: A curated collection whose primary research objects are digital images; use CORPUS when images are one modality in an analytically assembled corpus.
      ANNOTATION_SET:
        description: Standalone annotations, labels or enrichments applied to other data; use CORPUS when annotations are inseparable from the primary collected content.
      METADATA_CATALOG:
        description: Metadata records whose primary purpose is to describe or aggregate other resources; use datasets to link the datasets it catalogs and DATABASE for non-catalog structured records.
      OTHER_RESEARCH_DATA:
        description: Research data that fits none of the more specific forms; use only after the digital-edition, corpus, database, gazetteer, image-collection, annotation-set and metadata-catalog values have been considered.

  AuthorshipRoleEnum:
    description: The kind of contribution to a publication.
    permissible_values:
      AUTHOR:
        description: Byline author (the default).
      EDITOR:
        description: Editor of a volume or collection.
      TRANSLATOR:
        description: Translator of the work.
      CONTRIBUTOR:
        description: Named non-byline contribution.

  TrainingMaterialTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      Didactic forms of training material. Choose the form that describes the learner's intended mode of engagement rather than the resource's technical format.
    permissible_values:
      TUTORIAL:
        description: A step-by-step explanation of how to complete an action; use LESSON when conceptual instruction or stated outcomes are primary.
        meaning: schema:HowTo
      LESSON:
        description: A bounded unit designed to achieve learning outcomes; use TUTORIAL for primarily procedural, step-by-step guidance.
      COURSE_MATERIAL:
        description: A syllabus, module collection or resource pack supporting a structured course; use LESSON for one bounded instructional unit.
      WORKSHOP_MATERIAL:
        description: Exercises, slides or instructions designed for a facilitated workshop; use COURSE_MATERIAL for a longer structured course.
      SELF_PACED_EXERCISE:
        description: A practical activity intended for independent completion; use TUTORIAL when guided explanation rather than learner practice is primary.
      OTHER_DIDACTIC_RESOURCE:
        description: A teaching resource that fits none of the more specific forms; use only after the specific values have been considered.

  EventTypeEnum:
    description: Kinds of scholarly events.
    permissible_values:
      CONFERENCE:
        description: A multi-session academic conference.
        meaning: bibo:Conference
      WORKSHOP:
        description: A hands-on or small-group working meeting.
      SEMINAR:
        description: A recurring or one-off academic seminar session.
      LECTURE:
        description: A single public or academic talk.
      HACKATHON:
        description: A time-boxed collaborative building event.
      EXHIBITION:
        description: A curated public display (physical or digital).

  ToolServiceTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      Delivery forms for tools and kinds of services. Tool records use the software values; Service records use the service values.
    permissible_values:
      WEB_APPLICATION:
        description: Software used through a browser.
        meaning: schema:WebApplication
      DESKTOP_APPLICATION:
        description: Software installed on a user's machine.
      LIBRARY:
        description: A code library/package imported by other software.
      COMMAND_LINE_TOOL:
        description: Software operated from a terminal.
      DATABASE:
        description: A queryable data system offered as a tool.
      API_SERVICE:
        description: A programmatic service accessed over the network.
      DIGITIZATION_SERVICE:
        description: Human-mediated digitization (scanning, imaging, OCR).
      CONSULTING_SERVICE:
        description: Human-mediated expertise (methods, data, tech advice).

  LicenseEnum:
    description: >-
      Common licenses for tools, datasets and training materials.
      Extend as needed with canonical meanings.
    permissible_values:
      CC_BY_4_0:
        description: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.
        meaning: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
      CC_BY_SA_4_0:
        description: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0.
        meaning: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
      CC0_1_0:
        description: Creative Commons Zero (public domain dedication).
        meaning: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
      MIT:
        description: MIT License.
        meaning: spdx:MIT
      APACHE_2_0:
        description: Apache License 2.0.
        meaning: spdx:Apache-2.0
      GPL_3_0:
        description: GNU GPL v3.0 (or later).
        meaning: spdx:GPL-3.0-or-later
</code></pre>

items.title: JSON Schema
items.text:
<pre><code>{
  "$defs": {
    "Affiliation": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "A person's employment or membership at an organization, nested in a Person so the member is inferred from the containing record. Use in Person.affiliations for the person's institutional home(s), independent of any project; do not provide the containing person's ID in the relationship.",
      "properties": {
        "affiliation_role": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/PersonOrgRoleEnum",
          "description": "The person's position at the organization (their job/status, not their project role). Use EMPLOYEE when no finer value fits; AFFILIATE is for formal association without employment.",
          "x-termUri": "schema:roleName"
        },
        "end_date": {
          "description": "End of the event, project runtime or relationship. Omit for ongoing relationships and open-ended projects.",
          "format": "date",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "schema:endDate"
        },
        "organization": {
          "description": "The organization referenced by a person affiliation, facility affiliation or project role (by IDHI URN). The Person, Facility or Project containing the relationship supplies its other endpoint.",
          "type": "string",
          "x-termUri": "idhi:organization"
        },
        "start_date": {
          "description": "Start of the event, of the project's runtime, or of a relationship's validity, such as when participation, affiliation, maintenance responsibility or formal containment began.",
          "format": "date",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "schema:startDate"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "organization"
      ],
      "title": "Affiliation",
      "type": "object",
      "x-termUri": "cerif:Person_OrganisationUnit"
    },
    "Agent": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "A person or an organization.",
      "properties": {
        "description": {
          "description": "Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index visitors, not internal notes).",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/LangString"
          },
          "type": [
            "array",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "dcterms:description"
        },
        "homepage": {
          "description": "Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.",
          "format": "uri",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "foaf:homepage"
        },
        "id": {
          "description": "The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form\n  idhi:<class name>:<random short alphanumeric id>\ne.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1. Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed. The class token is the lowercase snake_case class name; each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage. External identifiers (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots — never here.",
          "pattern": "^idhi:[a-z_]+:[0-9a-z]{4,12}$",
          "type": "string",
          "x-termUri": "dcterms:identifier"
        },
        "image": {
          "description": "A representative image embedded as Base64-encoded binary content. Use for a single image that must travel with the entity record; omit it when no image is available, and use homepage or additional_urls for externally hosted pages rather than encoding a URL here.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "schema:image"
        },
        "same_as": {
          "description": "URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...). Use for linked-data alignment, not for the entity's own pages (use homepage).",
          "items": {
            "format": "uri",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": [
            "array",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "schema:sameAs"
        },
        "tags": {
          "description": "Free-text tags for discovery, filtering and grouping; usable on any top-level entity. Deliberately NOT a controlled enum, but prefer wording that matches a concept in an established ontology or thesaurus (e.g. Wikidata, Getty AAT, TaDiRAH) so tags can later be reconciled against it.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": [
            "array",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "dcat:keyword"
        },
        "type": {
          "description": "Discriminator identifying the record's class; used for polymorphic serialization and deserialization.",
          "type": "string",
          "x-termUri": "rdf:type"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "id"
      ],
      "title": "Agent",
      "type": "object",
      "x-termUri": "foaf:Agent"
    },
    "Authorship": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "A person's contribution nested in a Publication, so the publication is inferred from the containing record. Use one instance per author in Publication.authorships and do not define authorship in Person; author_order preserves the byline sequence with 1 as the first author.",
      "properties": {
        "author": {
          "description": "The person contributing to the containing publication (by IDHI URN). Use in Publication.authorships; do not define the relationship on the Person.",
          "type": "string",
          "x-termUri": "idhi:author"
        },
        "author_order": {
          "description": "Position in the byline; 1 = first author.",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "schema:position"
        },
        "authorship_role": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AuthorshipRoleEnum",
          "description": "The kind of contribution. AUTHOR is the default for byline authors; use EDITOR/TRANSLATOR for edited volumes and translations; CONTRIBUTOR for named non-byline contributions.",
          "x-termUri": "schema:roleName"
        },
        "end_date": {
          "description": "End of the event, project runtime or relationship. Omit for ongoing relationships and open-ended projects.",
          "format": "date",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "schema:endDate"
        },
        "start_date": {
          "description": "Start of the event, of the project's runtime, or of a relationship's validity, such as when participation, affiliation, maintenance responsibility or formal containment began.",
          "format": "date",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "schema:startDate"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "author"
      ],
      "title": "Authorship",
      "type": "object",
      "x-termUri": "schema:Role"
    },
    "AuthorshipRoleEnum": {
      "description": "The kind of contribution to a publication.",
      "enum": [
        "AUTHOR",
        "EDITOR",
        "TRANSLATOR",
        "CONTRIBUTOR"
      ],
      "title": "AuthorshipRoleEnum",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "CurrencyEnum": {
      "description": "Currencies in which a funding award amount may be expressed, as ISO 4217 codes. The list covers the currencies relevant to IDHI records; extend it before recording an award in another currency.",
      "enum": [
        "ILS",
        "USD",
        "EUR"
      ],
      "title": "CurrencyEnum",
      "type": "string",
      "x-termUris": {
        "ILS": "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q131309",
        "USD": "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4917",
        "EUR": "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4916"
      }
    },
    "Dataset": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "A dataset or dataset-like intellectual object produced or curated by a project: digital editions, corpora, databases, gazetteers, image collections, annotation sets and metadata catalogs. Use Dataset for research data, digital scholarly editions and catalogs that describe other resources; a catalog can link the datasets it aggregates through datasets.",
      "properties": {
        "byte_size": {
          "description": "Total size of the described dataset distribution in bytes. Use an exact or documented aggregate byte count and omit it when only an unreliable estimate is available.",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "dcat:byteSize"
        },
        "dataset_type": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/DatasetTypeEnum",
          "description": "The dataset's primary intellectual or collection form. Use this for discovery categories such as digital edition, corpus or gazetteer; use media_type for its technical serialization.",
          "x-termUri": "dcterms:type"
        },
        "datasets": {
          "description": "Datasets aggregated by a Dataset that functions as a catalog (by id).",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": [
            "array",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "dcat:dataset"
        },
        "date_issued": {
          "description": "Formal publication date (or year-01-01 if only the year is known).",
          "format": "date",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "dcterms:issued"
        },
        "derived_from": {
          "description": "Source datasets from which this dataset was re-OCRed, cleaned, transformed, subsetted or otherwise derived. Reference each immediate source by IDHI URN; use datasets only for catalog aggregation rather than provenance.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": [
            "array",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "prov:wasDerivedFrom"
        },
        "description": {
          "description": "Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index visitors, not internal notes).",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/LangString"
          },
          "type": [
            "array",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "dcterms:description"
        },
        "distribution_url": {
          "description": "Direct download or access URL for the dataset.",
          "format": "uri",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "dcat:downloadURL"
        },
        "doi": {
          "description": "The publication, dataset, tool or training material's DOI persistent identifier. Record it whenever one exists; it is the preferred deduplication key and is supplementary to the IDHI URN.",
          "format": "uri",
          "pattern": "https://doi.org/.+",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "bibo:doi"
        },
        "extent": {
          "description": "Technical extent statements such as record, item, issue, image or file counts. Use one concise statement per measure, include its unit, and use byte_size rather than prose for total bytes.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": [
            "array",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-termUri": "dcterms:extent"
        },
        "homepage": {
          "description": "Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.",
          "format": "uri",
          "type": [
            "string",

    },
    "TrainingMaterialTypeEnum": {
      "description": "Didactic forms of training material. Choose the form that describes the learner's intended mode of engagement rather than the resource's technical format.",
      "enum": [
        "TUTORIAL",
        "LESSON",
        "COURSE_MATERIAL",
        "WORKSHOP_MATERIAL",
        "SELF_PACED_EXERCISE",
        "OTHER_DIDACTIC_RESOURCE"
      ],
      "title": "TrainingMaterialTypeEnum",
      "type": "string",
      "x-termUris": {
        "TUTORIAL": "schema:HowTo"
      }
    }
  },
  "$id": "https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/idhi",
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema",
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "description": "Top-level holder for all IDHI records. Big entities live exactly once in these lists; everything else references them by their IDHI URN.",
  "metamodel_version": "1.11.0",
  "properties": {
    "datasets": {

      "items": {

        "null"
      ],
      "x-termUri": "idhi:datasets"
    },
    "events": {
      "description": "All Event records in the index.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Event"
      },
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "x-termUri": "idhi:events"
    },
    "facilities": {
      "description": "All Facility records in the index.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Facility"
      },
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "x-termUri": "idhi:facilities"
    },
    "organizations": {
      "description": "All Organization records in the index.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Organization"
      },
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "x-termUri": "idhi:organizations"
    },
    "persons": {
      "description": "All Person records in the index.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Person"
      },
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "x-termUri": "idhi:persons"
    },
    "projects": {
      "description": "All Project records in the index.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Project"
      },
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "x-termUri": "idhi:projects"
    },
    "publications": {
      "description": "All Publication records in the index.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Publication"
      },
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "x-termUri": "idhi:publications"
    },
    "services": {
      "description": "All Service records in the index.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Service"
      },
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "x-termUri": "idhi:services"
    },
    "tools": {
      "description": "All Tool records in the index.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Tool"
      },
