items.title: OWL/RDF ontology
items.text:
<pre><code>@prefix bibo: <http://purl.org/ontology/bibo/> .
@prefix cerif: <https://w3id.org/cerif/model#> .
@prefix coar: <http://purl.org/coar/resource_type/> .
@prefix dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> .
@prefix dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> .
@prefix idhi: <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/> .
@prefix linkml: <https://w3id.org/linkml/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix pav: <http://purl.org/pav/> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix schema1: <http://schema.org/> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix spdx: <https://spdx.org/licenses/> .
@prefix tadirah: <https://vocabs.dariah.eu/tadirah/> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

idhi:IndexContainer a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "IndexContainer" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Person ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:persons ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:TrainingMaterial ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:training_materials ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Event ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:events ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Project ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:projects ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:projects ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:publications ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Publication ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:publications ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Organization ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:organizations ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Dataset ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:datasets ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:services ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:persons ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:datasets ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:tools ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Facility ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:facilities ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:events ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Service ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:services ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Tool ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:tools ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:facilities ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:training_materials ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:organizations ] ;
    skos:definition "Top-level holder for all IDHI records. Big entities live exactly once in these lists; everything else references them by their IDHI URN." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:idhi.owl.ttl a owl:Ontology ;
    rdfs:label "idhi" ;
    dcterms:license "https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/" ;
    dcterms:title "Israeli Digital Humanities Index Schema" ;
    pav:version "0.1.0" ;
    skos:definition "A LinkML schema for an index of Digital Humanities (DH) research in Israel. Entities and properties reuse established vocabularies (FOAF, schema.org, Dublin Core Terms, BIBO, DCAT, PROV, EDM, SKOS, CERIF); DH projects are classified with TaDiRAH 2.0 research-activity concepts (dynamic enum over the full taxonomy). Free text supports any syntactically valid BCP-47 language tag. All entities are identified by IDHI URNs (idhi:<class>:<shortid>); external PIDs are supplementary." .

coar:1YTN-RJZE a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:1YTN-RJZE" ;
    dcterms:title "court documents" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A set of judicial proceedings that record, physically or digitally, and in an orderly fashion, the development of a process or procedural actions so that they may be recorded and examined by the parties. This would include the set of judicial proceedings and any item within that set as a physical or electronic court document. Adapted from https://dpej.rae.es/lema/expediente-judicial with input from https://www.supremecourt.gov/case_documents.aspx" .

coar:2H0M-X761 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:2H0M-X761" ;
    dcterms:title "geospatial data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Geospatial data are any type of data with spatial coordinates that allow them to be mapped to the Earth's surface. They can represent physical objects, discrete areas or continuous surfaces. Discrete geospatial data are usually represented using vector data consisting of points, lines and polygons, while continuous geospatial data are usually represented by raster data, consisting of a grid of cells that each has its own value. Any number of applications in a wide range of areas produce geospatial data, such as GIS, Remote Sensing equipment, GPS units, archaeological total stations, manual mapping and computer-aided design (CAD), in a number of formats, including images, vector, text, and tabular data. Vector-based geospatial data include tables listing archaeological sites along with their coordinates, text-based files (e.g., XML) containing coordinates and topology for historic road networks, voting figures for political parties by administrative area. Raster-based geospatial data include satellite images, aerial photographs, scanned maps, and digital maps of elevations, vegetation, land-use, sea surface temperatures, air pollution, soil-types, etc. [Source: https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/GeneralDataFormat_2.0.html]" .

coar:43KC-T6DC a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:43KC-T6DC" ;
    dcterms:title "magazine article" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "An Item appearing in a magazine (a general interest or specific focus periodical). This item is often shorter in length, is submitted by in-house and external authors. Adapted from MAGAZINE Definition & Meaning - Black's Law Dictionary (thelawdictionary.org)" .

coar:542X-3S04 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:542X-3S04" ;
    dcterms:title "design" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Plans, drawing or set of drawings showing how something e.g. building, product is to be made and how it will work and look. [Source: Adapted from https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/design]" .

coar:63NG-B465 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:63NG-B465" ;
    dcterms:title "experimental data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data resulting from the experimental research method involving the manipulation of some or all of the independent variables included in the hypotheses. [Source: Adapted from https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/ModeOfCollection_3.0.html]" .

coar:6NC7-GK9S a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:6NC7-GK9S" ;
    dcterms:title "transcription" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A written record of words spoken in court proceedings or in a speech, interview, broadcast, or sound recording. [Source: Adapted from https://products.abc-clio.com/ODLIS/odlis_t.aspx]" .

coar:8KJG-QS0Y a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:8KJG-QS0Y" ;
    dcterms:title "research instrument" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A device, tool or apparatus used to obtain, measure and/or analyze data. Source https://datacite-metadata-schema.readthedocs.io/en/4.5/appendices/appendix-1/resourceTypeGeneral/#instrument" .

coar:9DKX-KSAF a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:9DKX-KSAF" ;
    dcterms:title "utility model" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A special form of patent right granted by a state or jurisdiction to an inventor or the inventor’s assignee for a fixed period of time. The terms and conditions for granting a utility model are slightly different from those for normal patents (including a shorter term of protection and less stringent patentability requirements). The term can also describe what are known in certain countries as “petty patents,” “short-term patents” or “innovation patents.” [Source: https://www.wipo.int/edocs/pubdocs/en/wipo_pub_943_2018.pdf]" .

coar:A8F1-NPV9 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:A8F1-NPV9" ;
    dcterms:title "genomic data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Genomic data refers to the genome and DNA data of an organism. They are used in bioinformatics for collecting, storing and processing the genomes of living things. Genomic data is a more extensive term than sequencing data. However genomic data mostly come from sequencing techniques. It may include non-sequencing data such as data from microarrays, data from real-time PCR panels and data from pharmacogenomics studies. [Source: Adapted from https://www.techopedia.com/definition/31247/genomic-data]" .

coar:ACF7-8YT9 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:ACF7-8YT9" ;
    dcterms:title "aggregated data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Statistics that relate to broad classes, groups, or categories. The data are averaged, totaled, or otherwise derived from individual-level data, and it is no longer possible to distinguish the characteristics of individuals within those classes, groups, or categories. For example, the number and age group of the unemployed in specific geographic regions, or national level statistics on the occurrence of specific offences, originally derived from the statistics of individual police districts. [Source: https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/ModeOfCollection_3.0.html]" .

coar:AM6W-6QAW a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:AM6W-6QAW" ;
    dcterms:title "encoded data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Qualitative data (textual, video, audio or still-image) originally produced for other purposes into quantitative data (expressed in unit-by-variable matrices) by using coding techniques in accordance with pre-defined categorization schemes. For example, coded party manifesto data like the \"European Parliament Election Study 2009, Manifesto Study\" (doi:10.4232/1.10204)\". [Source: Adapted from https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/ModeOfCollection_3.0.html]" .

coar:BW7T-YM2G a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:BW7T-YM2G" ;
    dcterms:title "layout design" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Layout-design (topography) means the three-dimensional disposition, however expressed, of  the elements of an integrated circuit (at least one of which is an active element) and of some or all of the interconnections of an integrated circuit, or such a three-dimensional disposition prepared for  an integrated circuit intended for manufacture [Source: https://www.wipo.int/edocs/lexdocs/laws/en/hk/hk028en.pdf]" .

coar:C53B-JCY5 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:C53B-JCY5" ;
    dcterms:title "design patent" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A patent granted to any person who has invented any new and non-obvious ornamental design for an article of manufacture. The design patent protects only the appearance of an article, but not its structural or functional features. [Source: Adapted from https://www.uspto.gov/patents/basics/types-patent-applications/design-patent-application-guide#def]" .

coar:CQMR-7K63 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:CQMR-7K63" ;
    dcterms:title "recorded data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data registered by mechanical or electronic means, in a form that allows the information to be retrieved and/or reproduced. For example, images or sounds on disc or magnetic tape. [Source: Adapted from https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/ModeOfCollection_3.0.html]" .

coar:D97F-VB57 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:D97F-VB57" ;
    dcterms:title "commentary" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A commentary is a more in-depth analysis written to draw attention to a work already published. Commentaries are somewhat like “reviews” in that the author presents his or her analysis of a work and why it  would be of interest to a specific audience. [Source: https://www.enago.com/academy/perspective-opinion-and-commentary-pieces]" .

coar:DD58-GFSX a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:DD58-GFSX" ;
    dcterms:title "measurement and test data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data resulting from assessing specific properties (or characteristics) of beings, things, phenomena, (and/ or processes) by applying pre-established standards and/or specialized instruments or techniques. [Source: Adapted from  https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/ModeOfCollection_3.0.html]" .

coar:DX5J-TA9R a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:DX5J-TA9R" ;
    dcterms:title "knowledge synthesis protocol" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "In the context of systematic reviews and meta-analyses, a protocol is a document that presents an explicit plan for a systematic review. The protocol details the rationale and a priori methodological and analytical approach of the review. https://www.bmj.com/content/349/bmj.g7647" .

coar:EHVM-H119 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:EHVM-H119" ;
    dcterms:title "research data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data that are used as primary sources to support technical or scientific enquiry, research, scholarship, or artistic activity, and that are used as evidence in the research process and/or are commonly accepted in the research community as necessary to validate research findings and results. [Source: https://casrai.org/term/research-data]" .

coar:F8RT-TJK0 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:F8RT-TJK0" ;
    dcterms:title "artistic work" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A work of visual arts and performing arts, including musical works; dramatic works; pantomimes and choreographic works; motion picture and other audiovisual works; pictorial, graphic, sculptural and architectural works. Adapted from Law Insider: https://www.lawinsider.com/dictionary/artistic-works" .

coar:FF4C-28RK a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:FF4C-28RK" ;
    dcterms:title "observational data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data resulting from observational research, which involves collecting observations as they occur (for example, observing behaviors, events, development of condition or disease, etc.), without attempting to manipulate any of the independent variables. [Source:  Adapted from https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/ModeOfCollection_3.0.html]" .

coar:FXF3-D3G7 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:FXF3-D3G7" ;
    dcterms:title "compiled data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data collected or assembled from multiple, often heterogeneous sources that have one or more reference points in common, and at least one of the sources was originally produced for other purposes. The data are incorporated in a new entity. For example, providing data on the number of universities in the last 150 years using a variety of available sources (e.g. finance documents, official statistics, university registers), combining survey data with information about geographical areas from official statistics (e.g. population density, doctors per capita, etc.), or using RSS to collect blog posts or tweets, etc. [Source: Adapted from https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/ModeOfCollection_3.0.html]" .

coar:GPQ7-G5VE a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:GPQ7-G5VE" ;
    dcterms:title "plant variety protection" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Plant variety protection, also called a \"plant breeder's right\" (PBR), is a form of intellectual property right granted to the breeder of a new plant variety . According to this right, certain acts concerning the exploitation of the protected variety require the prior authorization of the breeder. Plant variety protection is an independent sui generis form of protection, tailored to protect new plant varieties and has certain features in common with other intellectual property rights. [Source: https://www.wipo.int/edocs/pubdocs/en/wipo_pub_943_2018.pdf]" .

coar:GSZA-Y7V7 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:GSZA-Y7V7" ;
    dcterms:title "knowledge organization system" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "All types of schemes for organizing information and promoting knowledge management. Knowledge organization systems include classification schemes that organize materials at a general level (such as books on a shelf), subject headings that provide more detailed access, and authority files that control variant versions of key information (such as geographic names and personal names). They also include less-traditional schemes, such as semantic artifacts, semantic networks and ontologies. https://www.clir.org/pubs/reports/pub91/1knowledge/" .

coar:H41Y-FW7B a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:H41Y-FW7B" ;
    dcterms:title "laboratory notebook" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A laboratory notebook (colloq. lab notebook or lab book) is a primary record of research. Researchers use a lab notebook to document their hypotheses, experiments and initial analysis or interpretation of these experiments. This label is used both for traditional and electronic laboratory notebook. [Source: Adapted from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lab_notebook]" .

coar:H6QP-SC1X a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:H6QP-SC1X" ;
    dcterms:title "trademark" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A sign used to distinguish the goods or services of one undertaking from those of others. A trademark may consist of words and combinations of words (for instance, names or slogans), logos, figures and images, letters, numbers, sounds, or, in rare instances, smells or moving images, or a combination thereof. [Source: https://www.wipo.int/trademarks/en]" .

coar:H9BQ-739P a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:H9BQ-739P" ;
    dcterms:title "peer review" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "An evaluation of scientific, academic, or professional work by others working in the same field. [Source: Adopted from https://schema.datacite.org/meta/kernel-4.4/doc/DataCite-MetadataKernel_v4.4.pdf]" .

coar:JBNF-DYAD a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:JBNF-DYAD" ;
    dcterms:title "industrial design" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Industrial designs are applied to a wide variety of industrial products and handicrafts. They refer to the ornamental or aesthetic aspects of a useful article,including compositions of lines or colors or any three-dimensional forms that give a special appearance to a product or handicraft. [Source: https://www.wipo.int/edocs/pubdocs/en/wipo_pub_943_2018.pdf]" .

coar:MW8G-3CR8 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:MW8G-3CR8" ;
    dcterms:title "software patent" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "In order to obtain a patent, a software invention must not fall under other non-patentable subject matter (for example, abstract ideas or mathematical theories) and has to fulfill the other substantive patentability criteria (for example, novelty, inventive step [non-obviousness] and industrial applicability [usefulness]). [Source: https://www.wipo.int/patents/en/faq_patents.html]" .

coar:NHD0-W6SY a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:NHD0-W6SY" ;
    dcterms:title "survey data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data resulting from a survey, which is defined as an investigation about the characteristics of a given population by means of collecting data from a sample of that population and estimating their characteristics through the systematic use of statistical methodology. Included are censuses, sample surveys, the collection of data from administrative records and derived statistical activities as well as questionnaires. [Source: Adapted from https://stats.oecd.org/glossary/detail.asp?ID=2620]" .

coar:QH80-2R4E a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:QH80-2R4E" ;
    dcterms:title "source code" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Source code is any collection of code, with or without comments, written using a human-readable programming language, usually as plain text. [Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Source_code]" .

coar:QX5C-AR31 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:QX5C-AR31" ;
    dcterms:title "other periodical" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A resource type that is not included in existing terms under the top concept \"Text\". [COAR definition]" .

coar:R60J-J5BD a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:R60J-J5BD" ;
    dcterms:title "conference presentation" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A set of slides containing text, tables or figures, designed to communicate ideas or research results, for projection and viewing by an audience at a conference, symposium, seminar, lecture, workshop or other gatherings. [Source: Adapted from hhttps://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e4880]" .

coar:RMP5-3GQ6 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:RMP5-3GQ6" ;
    dcterms:title "collection" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "An aggregation of resources, which may encompass collections of one resourceType as well as those of mixed types. A collection is described as a group; its parts may also be separately described. https://datacite-metadata-schema.readthedocs.io/en/4.5/appendices/appendix-1/resourceTypeGeneral/#collection" .

coar:S7R1-K5P0 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:S7R1-K5P0" ;
    dcterms:title "physical sample" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Physical samples include biological specimens, rock or mineral specimens, soil or sediment cores, plants and seeds, water quality samples, archaeological artefacts, or DNA and human tissue samples. Samples may be used in analyses and can be destroyed in this process, whereas specimens are preserved curated objects that can be continuously studied. Source: 23 Things Physical Samples https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/309016/1/309016.pdf" .

coar:SB3Y-W4EH a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:SB3Y-W4EH" ;
    dcterms:title "PCT application" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A patent application filed through the WIPO-administered Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT), also known as an international application. [Source: Adapted from https://www.wipo.int/edocs/pubdocs/en/wipo_pub_943_2018.pdf]" .

coar:W2XT-7017 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:W2XT-7017" ;
    dcterms:title "simulation data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data resulting from modeling or imitative representation of real-world processes, events, or systems, often using computer programs. For example, a program modeling household consumption responses to indirect tax changes; or a dataset on hypothetical patients and their drug exposure, background conditions, and known adverse events. [Source: Adapted from https://ddialliance.org/Specification/DDI-CV/ModeOfCollection_3.0.html]" .

coar:YC9F-HGCF a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:YC9F-HGCF" ;
    dcterms:title "archival collection" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A collection of historical records and primary source documents. Documents may be tangible or digital. Adapted from “archive (groupings)” in Getty AAT: https://www.getty.edu/vow/AATFullDisplay?find=maiolica&logic=AND&note=&subjectid=300375748" .

coar:YZ1N-ZFT9 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:YZ1N-ZFT9" ;
    dcterms:title "research protocol" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "The protocol is a detailed plan of the research study including a project summary, project description covering the rationale, objectives, methodology, data management and analysis, ethical considerations, gender issues and references. [Source: Adapted from https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/a-practical-guide-for-health-researchers]" .

coar:Z907-YMBB a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:Z907-YMBB" ;
    dcterms:title "plant patent" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A patent granted to anyone who has invented or discovered and asexually reproduced any distinct and new variety of plant, including cultivated sports, mutants, hybrids, and newly found seedlings, other than a tuber-propagated plant or a plant found in an uncultivated state. [Source: Adapted from https://www.uspto.gov/patents/basics/types-patent-applications/general-information-about-35-usc-161#heading-1]" .

coar:c_0040 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_0040" ;
    dcterms:title "manuscript" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A manuscript is a work of any kind (text, inscription, music score, map, etc.) written entirely by hand. [Source: https://products.abc-clio.com/ODLIS/odlis_m.aspx]" .

coar:c_0640 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_0640" ;
    dcterms:title "journal" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A journal is a serial publication devoted to disseminating original research and current developments on a subject. (Adapted from ODLIS) [Source: http://dspacecris.eurocris.org/cris/classcerif/classcerif00422]" .

coar:c_0857 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_0857" ;
    dcterms:title "letter" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A brief description of important new research, also known as “communication”. [Source: https://cerif.eurocris.org/vocab/html/OutputTypes.html#Letter]" .

coar:c_1162 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_1162" ;
    dcterms:title "annotation" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "An annotation in the sense of a legal note is a legally explanatory comment on a decision handed down by a court or arbitral tribunal. [Source: DRIVER info:eu-repo definition]" .

coar:c_12cc a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_12cc" ;
    dcterms:title "cartographic material" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Any material representing the whole or part of the earth or any celestial body at any scale. Cartographic materials include two- and three-dimensional maps and plans (including maps of imaginary places); aeronautical, navigational, and celestial charts; atlases; globes; block diagrams; sections; aerial photographs with a cartographic purpose; bird's-eye views (map views), etc. [Source: http://www.loc.gov/marc/cfmap.html]" .

coar:c_12cd a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_12cd" ;
    dcterms:title "map" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Defined as a representation normally to scale and on a flat medium, of a selection of material or abstract features on, or in relation to, the surface of the earth or of another celestial body. [Source: https://www.loc.gov/marc/bibliographic/bd007a.html]" .

coar:c_12ce a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_12ce" ;
    dcterms:title "video" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Media that makes use of images (usually \"moving\"), with or without sound, over a period of playback time. [Source :https://support.contributors.jstor.org/hc/en-us/articles/11971132444439-JSTOR-Content-and-Resource-Types]" .

coar:c_15cd a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_15cd" ;
    dcterms:title "patent" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A patent or patent application." .

coar:c_1843 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_1843" ;
    dcterms:title "other" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A resource type that is not included in existing terms. [COAR definition]" .

coar:c_186u a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_186u" ;
    dcterms:title "policy report" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A policy report presents what is known about a particular issue or problem. It assembles facts and evidence to help readers understand complex issues and form a response. It might aim to be neutral, or it might aim to persuade readers in a particular direction. [Source: https://www.uow.edu.au/student/learning-co-op/assessments/policy-report/#]" .

coar:c_18cc a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18cc" ;
    dcterms:title "sound" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A resource primarily intended to be heard. Examples include a music playback file format, an audio compact disc, and recorded speech or sounds. [Source: http://dublincore.org/documents/dcmi-terms/#dcmitype-Sound]" .

coar:c_18cd a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18cd" ;
    dcterms:title "musical composition" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Musical composition can refer to an original piece of music, the structure of a musical piece, or the process of creating a new piece of music. [Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musical_composition ]" .

coar:c_18cf a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18cf" ;
    dcterms:title "text" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A resource consisting primarily of words for reading. Examples include books, letters, dissertations, poems, newspapers, articles, archives of mailing lists. Note that facsimiles or images of texts are still of the genre Text. [Source: http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/Text]" .

coar:c_18co a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18co" ;
    dcterms:title "conference poster not in proceedings" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A display poster, typically containing text with illustrative figures and/or tables, usually reporting research results or proposing hypotheses, submitted for acceptance to and/or presented at a conference, seminar, symposium, workshop or similar event. Use this label when the poster is not published in a proceeding. [Source: http://purl.org/spar/fabio/ConferencePoster]" .

coar:c_18cp a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18cp" ;
    dcterms:title "conference paper not in proceedings" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A paper, typically the realization of a research paper reporting original research findings. Use this label when the paper is not published in a proceeding. [Source: Adapted from http://purl.org/spar/fabio/ConferencePaper]" .

coar:c_18cw a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18cw" ;
    dcterms:title "musical notation" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Symbols used to write music, as in a music score, and to express mathematical concepts. [Source: Adapted from https://products.abc-clio.com/ODLIS/odlis_n.aspx]" .

coar:c_18gh a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18gh" ;
    dcterms:title "technical report" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A document that describes the process, progress, or results of technical or scientific research or the state of a technical or scientific research problem. It might also include recommendations and conclusions of the research. [Source: http://guides.library.cornell.edu/ecommons/types]" .

coar:c_18hj a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18hj" ;
    dcterms:title "report to funding agency" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A report to a funding agency is a document written by beneficiaries of project grants. The reporting documents can be e.g. periodic reports about progress of scientific and technical work and final report. For deliverables use ‘Project deliverable’. [Source: http://ec.europa.eu/research/participants/fp7documents/funding-guide/6_projects/reports/reports_en.htm ]" .

coar:c_18op a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18op" ;
    dcterms:title "project deliverable" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A document containing a project report, intended to be delivered to a customer or funding agency describing the results achieved within a specific project. [Source: https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e5183]" .

coar:c_18wq a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18wq" ;
    dcterms:title "other type of report" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Other types of report may include Business Plans Technical Specifications, data management plans, recommendation reports, white papers, annual reports, auditor's reports, workplace reports, census reports, trip reports, progress reports, investigative reports, budget reports, policy reports, demographic reports, credit reports, appraisal reports, inspection reports, military reports, bound reports, etc. [Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Report]" .

coar:c_18ws a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18ws" ;
    dcterms:title "research report" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "It is publication that reports on the findings of a research project or alternatively scientific observations on or about a subject. [Source: Adapted from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Research_report]" .

coar:c_18ww a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18ww" ;
    dcterms:title "internal report" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "An internal report is a record of findings collected for internal use. It is not designed to be made public and may include confidential or proprietary information." .

coar:c_18wz a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_18wz" ;
    dcterms:title "memorandum" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A formal note distributed internally to one or more persons in a company, agency, organization, or institution, with a header indicating the date it was sent and stating to whom it is addressed (To:), from whom it is sent (From:), and the subject of the text (Re:). Unlike a letter, a memo does not require a full salutation or signature at the end of the text--the sender may simply initial his or her name in the header. [Source: https://products.abc-clio.com/ODLIS/odlis_m.aspx#memorandum]" .

coar:c_2659 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_2659" ;
    dcterms:title "periodical" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A periodical is a serial publication with its own distinctive title, characterized by a variety of contents and contributors, and issued at regular intervals. (Adapted from ODLIS) [Source: http://www.abc-clio.com/ODLIS/odlis_p.aspx]" .

coar:c_26e4 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_26e4" ;
    dcterms:title "interview" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A discussion between a reporter, host, panel, or audience and a newsmaker, author, or celebrity, recorded (edited or unedited) in print, on film or video, as transcript or as a sound recording. (Adapted from ODLIS)" .

coar:c_2cd9 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_2cd9" ;
    dcterms:title "magazine" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A popular interest periodical usually containing articles on a variety of topics, written by various authors in a nonscholarly style or a trade publication, unlike a consumer publication, covers a specific topic for people who work in that particular field or industry. [Source: Adapted from https://www.thebalance.com/what-is-a-trade-publication-exactly-2316039 and http://www.abc-clio.com/ODLIS/odlis_m.aspx]" .

coar:c_2df8fbb1 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_2df8fbb1" ;
    dcterms:title "research article" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A research article is a primary source, that is, it reports the methods and results of an original study performed by the authors. (adapted from http://apus.libanswers.com/faq/2324)" .

coar:c_2f33 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_2f33" ;
    dcterms:title "book" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A non-serial publication that is complete in one volume or a designated finite number of volumes. [Source: Adapted from http://purl.org/eprint/type/Book]" .

coar:c_2fe3 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_2fe3" ;
    dcterms:title "newspaper" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A non-peer reviewed periodical, usually published daily or weekly, consisting primarily of editorials and news items concerning current or recent events and matters of public interest. [Source: https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e4291]" .

coar:c_3248 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_3248" ;
    dcterms:title "book part" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A defined chapter or section of a book, usually with a separate title or number. [Source: http://purl.org/spar/fabio/BookChapter]" .

coar:c_393c a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_393c" ;
    dcterms:title "workflow" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A recorded sequence of connected steps, which may be automated, specifying a reliably repeatable sequence of operations to be undertaken when conducting a particular job, for example an in silico investigation that extracts and processes information from a number of bioinformatics databases. [Source: Adapted from https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e6123]" .

coar:c_3e5a a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_3e5a" ;
    dcterms:title "contribution to journal" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A contribution to a journal denotes a work published in a journal. If applicable sub-terms should be chosen." .

coar:c_46ec a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_46ec" ;
    dcterms:title "thesis" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A book authored by a student containing a formal presentations of research outputs submitted for examination in completion of a course of study at an institution of higher education, to fulfil the requirements for an academic degree. Also known as a dissertation. [Source: https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e5748]" .

coar:c_545b a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_545b" ;
    dcterms:title "letter to the editor" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A letter addressed to the editor and comments on or discussed an item previously published by that periodical, or of interest to its readership. [Source: Adapted from hhttps://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e3803]" .

coar:c_5794 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_5794" ;
    dcterms:title "conference paper" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A paper, published within a conference proceeding, typically the realization of a research paper reporting original research findings. [Source: Adapted from https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e2635]" .

coar:c_5ce6 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_5ce6" ;
    dcterms:title "software" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A computer program in source code (text) or compiled form. [Source: http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/Software]" .

coar:c_6501 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_6501" ;
    dcterms:title "journal article" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "An article, typically the realization of a research paper reporting original research findings, published in a journal issue. [Source: https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e3646]" .

coar:c_6670 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_6670" ;
    dcterms:title "conference poster" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A display poster, published within a conference proceeding, typically containing text with illustrative figures and/or tables, usually reporting research results or proposing hypotheses, submitted for acceptance to and/or presented at a conference, seminar, symposium, workshop or similar event. [Source: Adapted https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e2648]" .

coar:c_6947 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_6947" ;
    dcterms:title "blog post" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A piece of writing or other item of content published on a blog. [Source: https://www.lexico.com/definition/blog_post]" .

coar:c_71bd a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_71bd" ;
    dcterms:title "technical documentation" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Technical documentation refers to any type of documentation that describes handling, functionality and architecture of a technical product or a product under development or use. [Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_documentation]" .

coar:c_7877 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_7877" ;
    dcterms:title "clinical study" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A work that reports on the results of a research study to evaluate interventions or exposures on biomedical or health-related outcomes. The two main types of clinical studies are interventional studies (clinical trials) and observational studies. While most clinical studies concern humans, this publication type may be used for clinical veterinary articles meeting the requisites for humans. [Source: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/2009830]" .

coar:c_7a1f a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_7a1f" ;
    dcterms:title "bachelor thesis" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A thesis reporting a research project undertaken as part of an undergraduate course of education leading to a bachelor's degree. [Source: https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e2181]" .

coar:c_7acd a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_7acd" ;
    dcterms:title "corrigendum" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A formal correction to an error introduced by the author into a previously published document. (adapted from https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e2712)" .

coar:c_7ad9 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_7ad9" ;
    dcterms:title "website" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A collection of related web pages containing text, images, videos and/or other digital assets that are addressed relative to a common Uniform Resource Locator (URL). A web site is hosted on at least one web server, accessible via a network such as the Internet or a private local area network. [Source: http://purl.org/spar/fabio/WebSite]" .

coar:c_7bab a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_7bab" ;
    dcterms:title "software paper" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A software paper should include the rationale for the development of the tool and details of the code used for its construction. [Source: Adapted from https://f1000research.com/for-authors/article-guidelines/software-tool-articles ]" .

coar:c_8042 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_8042" ;
    dcterms:title "working paper" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A working or discussion paper circulated publicly or among a group of peers. Certain disciplines, for example economics, issue working papers in series. [Source: http://www.ukoln.ac.uk/repositories/digirep/index/Eprints_Type_Vocabulary_Encoding_Scheme#:~:text=http%3A//purl.org/eprint/type/WorkingPaper]" .

coar:c_816b a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_816b" ;
    dcterms:title "preprint" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A preprint is a scientific manuscript without peer-review and has not yet been accepted by a journal, typicaly submitted to a public server/ repository by the author. [Source: Adapted from https://asapbio.org/preprint-info/preprint-faq#qaef-637]" .

coar:c_8544 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_8544" ;
    dcterms:title "lecture" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Transcription of an oral presentation/talk intended to present information or teach people about a particular subject, for example by a university or college teacher. [Source: Adopted from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lecture]" .

coar:c_86bc a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_86bc" ;
    dcterms:title "bibliography" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article [Source: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/bibliography]" .

coar:c_8a7e a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_8a7e" ;
    dcterms:title "moving image" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A moving display, either generated dynamically by a computer program or formed from a series of pre-recorded still images imparting an impression of motion when shown in succession. [Source: http://purl.org/spar/fabio/MovingImage]" .

coar:c_93fc a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_93fc" ;
    dcterms:title "report" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A report is a separately published record of research findings, research still in progress, policy developments and events, or other technical findings, usually bearing a report number and sometimes a grant number assigned by the funding agency. Also, an official record of the activities of a committee or corporate entity, the proceedings of a government body, or an investigation by an agency, whether published or private, usually archived or submitted to a higher authority, voluntarily or under mandate. In a more general sense, any formal account of facts or information related to a specific event or phenomenon, sometimes given at regular intervals. [Source: http://lu.com/odlis/odlis_R.cfm#report ]" .

coar:c_998f a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_998f" ;
    dcterms:title "newspaper article" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Work consisting of a news item appearing in a general-interest newspaper or other general news periodical, containing information of current and timely interest in a field. (Adapted from http://www.reference.md/files/D018/mD018431.html )" .

coar:c_ab20 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_ab20" ;
    dcterms:title "data management plan" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A formal statement describing how research data will be managed and documented throughout a research project and the terms regarding the subsequent deposit of the data with a data repository for long-term management and preservation. [Source: https://casrai.org/rdm-glossary]" .

coar:c_b239 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_b239" ;
    dcterms:title "editorial" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A brief essay expressing the opinion or position of the chief editor(s) of a (academic) journal with respect to a current political, social, cultural, or professional issue. [Source: Adapted from ODLIS [Source: http://www.abc-clio.com/ODLIS/odlis_e.aspx ]" .

coar:c_ba08 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_ba08" ;
    dcterms:title "book review" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A written review and critical analysis of the content, scope and quality of a book or other monographic work. [Source: https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e2300]" .

coar:c_ba1f a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_ba1f" ;
    dcterms:title "report part" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "part of a report" .

coar:c_baaf a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_baaf" ;
    dcterms:title "research proposal" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A research proposal is a document proposing a research project, generally in the sciences or academia, and generally constitutes a request for sponsorship of that research. [Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Research_proposal]" .

coar:c_bdcc a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_bdcc" ;
    dcterms:title "master thesis" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A thesis reporting a research project undertaken as part of a graduate course of education leading to a master's degree. [Source: https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e4057]" .

coar:c_beb9 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_beb9" ;
    dcterms:title "data paper" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A data paper is a scholarly publication describing a particular dataset or group of dataset, published in the form of a peer-reviewed article in a scholarly journal. The main purpose of a data paper is to describe data, the circumstances of their collection, and information related to data features, access and potential reuse. Adapted from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_paper and http://www.gbif.org/publishing-data/data-papers" .

coar:c_c513 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_c513" ;
    dcterms:title "image" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A visual representation other than text, including all types of moving image and still image. [Source: Adapted from  http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/Image]" .

coar:c_c94f a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_c94f" ;
    dcterms:title "conference output" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "All kind of digital resources contributed to a conference, like conference presentation (slides), conference report, conference lecture, abstracts, demonstrations. For conference papers, posters or proceedings the specific sub-concepts should be used. [COAR definition]" .

coar:c_c950 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_c950" ;
    dcterms:title "research software" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Software that is used to generate, process or analyse results that you intend to appear in a publication (either in a journal, conference paper, monograph, book or thesis). Research software can be anything from a few lines of code written by yourself, to a professionally developed software package. [Source: https://datashare.ed.ac.uk/handle/10283/785]" .

coar:c_cb28 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_cb28" ;
    dcterms:title "clinical trial data" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Data resulting from a research study in which one or more human subjects are prospectively assigned to one or more interventions (which may include placebo or other control) to evaluate the effects of those interventions on health-related biomedical or behavioral outcomes. [Source: Adapted from https://grants.nih.gov/policy/clinical-trials/definition.htm]" .

coar:c_db06 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_db06" ;
    dcterms:title "doctoral thesis" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A thesis reporting the research undertaken during a period of graduate study leading to a doctoral degree. [Source: https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e3051]" .

coar:c_dcae04bc a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_dcae04bc" ;
    dcterms:title "review article" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A review article is a secondary source, that is, it is written about other articles, and does not report original research of its own. [Source: Adapted from http://apus.libanswers.com/faq/2324]" .

coar:c_ddb1 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_ddb1" ;
    dcterms:title "dataset" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A collection of related facts and data encoded in a defined structure. [Source: Adapted from http://purl.org/spar/fabio/Dataset]" .

coar:c_e059 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_e059" ;
    dcterms:title "learning object" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A digital resource that can be reused to enhance teaching and learning. Source https://icas-ca.org/archive/projects/coerc/oer-glossary/" .

coar:c_e9a0 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_e9a0" ;
    dcterms:title "interactive resource" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A resource requiring interaction from the user to be understood, executed, or experienced. Examples include forms on Web pages, applets, multimedia learning objects, chat services, or virtual reality environments. Source: http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/InteractiveResource" .

coar:c_ecc8 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_ecc8" ;
    dcterms:title "still image" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A recorded static visual representation. This class of image includes diagrams, drawings, graphs, graphic designs, plans, photographs and prints. [Source: Adapted from  http://purl.org/spar/fabio/StillImage]" .

coar:c_efa0 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_efa0" ;
    dcterms:title "review" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A review of others' published work. [Source: Adapted from https://sparontologies.github.io/fabio/current/fabio.html#d4e5273]" .

coar:c_f744 a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "coar:c_f744" ;
    dcterms:title "conference proceedings" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Conference proceedings is the official record of a conference meeting. It is a collection of documents which corresponds to the presentations given at the conference. It may include additional content. [Source: http://www.ieee.org/documents/confprocdefined.pdf ]" .

dcterms:contributor a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CONTRIBUTOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ResourceContributionRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Makes a named contribution that does not fit creator, developer, maintainer or data curator; use only after the more specific roles have been considered." .

dcterms:creator a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CREATOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ResourceContributionRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Originates the resource as a whole; use DEVELOPER for software implementation and DATA_CURATOR for stewardship of dataset contents." .

bibo:Conference a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CONFERENCE" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A multi-session academic conference." .

schema1:CollegeOrUniversity a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "ACADEMIC_INSTITUTION" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:OrganizationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A degree-granting university or college." .

schema1:Corporation a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "COMPANY" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:OrganizationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A commercial company." .

schema1:FundingScheme a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "FUNDER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:OrganizationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A body whose primary role is funding research." .

schema1:HowTo a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "TUTORIAL" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:TrainingMaterialTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A step-by-step explanation of how to complete an action; use LESSON when conceptual instruction or stated outcomes are primary." .

schema1:NGO a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "NON_PROFIT" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:OrganizationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A non-profit organization / NGO." .

schema1:ResearchOrganization a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "RESEARCH_CENTER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:OrganizationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A research center or institute, whether independent or within a university; when it is structurally contained in another organization, also add organization_structure with that parent and any known dates." .

schema1:WebApplication a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "WEB_APPLICATION" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ToolServiceTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Software used through a browser." .

schema1:attendee a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "PARTICIPANT" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventAgentRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Takes an active named part in the event when no more specific organizer, host, speaker or panelist role applies; do not use for unrecorded general attendance." .

schema1:maintainer a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "MAINTAINER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ResourceContributionRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Holds ongoing technical or operational responsibility for the resource after its creation; use DEVELOPER for implementation work without continuing maintenance responsibility." .

schema1:organizer a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "ORGANIZER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventAgentRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Plans or administers the event; use HOST for the institution providing the venue or institutional home." .

schema1:owns a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "OWNER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:FacilityAffiliationRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "The organization legally or administratively owns the facility; use HOST instead when it operates or houses a facility it does not own." .

schema1:provider a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "DATA_PROVIDER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:OrgProjectRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Supplies a source collection or data used by the project without thereby acting as its host, coordinator or funder." .

schema1:sponsor a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "SPONSOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventAgentRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Provides financial or material sponsorship for the event; use ORGANIZER when the same agent also administers the event." .

    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:CurrencyEnum ;
    skos:definition "Euro; use for awards denominated in euros, such as European Union programme grants, not for converted approximations of another currency." .

<http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4917> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "USD" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:CurrencyEnum ;
    skos:definition "United States dollar; use for awards denominated in dollars, not for converted approximations of another currency." .

<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CC_BY_SA_4_0" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:LicenseEnum ;
    skos:definition "Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0." .

<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CC_BY_4_0" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:LicenseEnum ;
    skos:definition "Creative Commons Attribution 4.0." .

<https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CC0_1_0" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:LicenseEnum ;
    skos:definition "Creative Commons Zero (public domain dedication)." .

<https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/data-curation/> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "DATA_CURATOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ResourceContributionRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Manages, cleans, annotates, preserves or documents the contents of a Dataset; use CREATOR for originating the resource as a whole." .

<https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/investigation/> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "RESEARCHER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ProjectRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "A team member conducting the scholarly research." .

<https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/methodology/> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "DH_LEAD" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ProjectRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Leads the project's digital-humanities method, data model, research pipeline or digital-edition architecture. Use this for intellectual leadership of the digital approach, distinct from the formal PI and from software implementation." .

<https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/supervision/> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "ADVISOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ProjectRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "An external mentor or advisory-board member providing ongoing guidance; use CONSULTANT for bounded professional work with a defined deliverable." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#AUTHOR> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "AUTHOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:AuthorshipRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Byline author (the default)." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#CONTRIBUTOR> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CONTRIBUTOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:AuthorshipRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Named non-byline contribution." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#EDITOR> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "EDITOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:AuthorshipRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Editor of a volume or collection." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#TRANSLATOR> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "TRANSLATOR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:AuthorshipRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Translator of the work." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/DatasetTypeEnum#ANNOTATION_SET> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "ANNOTATION_SET" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Standalone annotations, labels or enrichments applied to other data; use CORPUS when annotations are inseparable from the primary collected content." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/DatasetTypeEnum#CORPUS> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CORPUS" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A curated collection of texts, images, recordings or records assembled primarily for research or computational analysis; use IMAGE_COLLECTION when images are the defining intellectual form." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/DatasetTypeEnum#DATABASE> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "DATABASE" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Structured records designed primarily for querying and ongoing data management; use GAZETTEER for place-centered authority data and METADATA_CATALOG for records describing other resources." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/DatasetTypeEnum#DIGITAL_EDITION> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "DIGITAL_EDITION" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A scholarly or documentary edition whose edited texts, apparatus or aligned versions are delivered digitally; use CORPUS for a collection intended primarily for analysis rather than editorial presentation." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/DatasetTypeEnum#GAZETTEER> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "GAZETTEER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Structured place-name or geographic authority data connecting names, places and often historical attestations; use DATABASE for non-geographic structured data." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/DatasetTypeEnum#IMAGE_COLLECTION> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "IMAGE_COLLECTION" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A curated collection whose primary research objects are digital images; use CORPUS when images are one modality in an analytically assembled corpus." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/DatasetTypeEnum#METADATA_CATALOG> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "METADATA_CATALOG" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Metadata records whose primary purpose is to describe or aggregate other resources; use datasets to link the datasets it catalogs and DATABASE for non-catalog structured records." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/DatasetTypeEnum#OTHER_RESEARCH_DATA> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "OTHER_RESEARCH_DATA" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "Research data that fits none of the more specific forms; use only after the digital-edition, corpus, database, gazetteer, image-collection, annotation-set and metadata-catalog values have been considered." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/EventAgentRoleEnum#HOST> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "HOST" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventAgentRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Provides the event's venue or institutional home without necessarily organizing its programme. No established controlled concept precisely distinguishes this role from organizer." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/EventAgentRoleEnum#PANELIST> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "PANELIST" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventAgentRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Participates as a named member of a panel; use SPEAKER for a standalone talk and PARTICIPANT for another active capacity." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/EventAgentRoleEnum#SPEAKER> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "SPEAKER" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventAgentRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "Delivers a lecture, presentation or other individual spoken contribution; use PANELIST for participation in a panel discussion." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/EventTypeEnum#EXHIBITION> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "EXHIBITION" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A curated public display (physical or digital)." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/EventTypeEnum#HACKATHON> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "HACKATHON" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A time-boxed collaborative building event." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/EventTypeEnum#LECTURE> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "LECTURE" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A single public or academic talk." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/EventTypeEnum#SEMINAR> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "SEMINAR" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A recurring or one-off academic seminar session." .

<https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/EventTypeEnum#WORKSHOP> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "WORKSHOP" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:EventTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "A hands-on or small-group working meeting." .

    rdfs:range idhi:LangString ;
    skos:definition "Name of the journal, book or proceedings the publication appeared in, as free multilingual text. If the container work has its own IDHI record or external URI, also link it via part_of." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:related_datasets a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "related_datasets" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Dataset ;
    skos:definition "Datasets used as the subject or worked example of the material (by IDHI URN). Do not use this for incidental source data that learners never encounter." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:related_publications a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "related_publications" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Publication ;
    skos:definition "Publications that are counterparts or direct scholarly companions of the dataset, such as the print counterpart of a digital edition. Reference Publication records by IDHI URN; use outputs_publications on Project for outputs that are related only by their project of origin." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:related_services a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "related_services" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Service ;
    skos:definition "Services that the material explains how to access or use (by IDHI URN). Do not use this for the organization publishing the material." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:related_tools a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "related_tools" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Tool ;
    skos:definition "Tools whose use the material teaches or demonstrates (by IDHI URN). Do not use this merely for software used to produce the material." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:research_disciplines a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "research_disciplines" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:LangString ;
    skos:definition "Humanities discipline(s) of the project (history, linguistics, archaeology...). Free multilingual text for now; a controlled vocabulary is a planned upgrade." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:same_as a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "same_as" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...). Use for linked-data alignment, not for the entity's own pages (use homepage)." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:services a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "services" ;
    skos:definition "All Service records in the index." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:services_offered a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "services_offered" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Service ;
    skos:definition "Services this facility offers to researchers. Reference Service records by id; the Service's own 'provider' may still point at the parent Organization." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:studied_periods a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "studied_periods" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:LangString ;
    skos:definition "Historical period(s) the project studies (e.g. Ottoman period), as free multilingual labels — distinct from the project's own start_date/end_date." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:studied_places a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "studied_places" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:LangString ;
    skos:definition "Geographic focus of the research (places studied), as free multilingual labels — distinct from where the project team sits." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:tags a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "tags" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:definition "Free-text tags for discovery, filtering and grouping; usable on any top-level entity. Deliberately NOT a controlled enum, but prefer wording that matches a concept in an established ontology or thesaurus (e.g. Wikidata, Getty AAT, TaDiRAH) so tags can later be reconciled against it." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:target_audiences a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "target_audiences" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:LangString ;

    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:themes a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "themes" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:LangString ;
    skos:definition "Thematic keywords for the dataset, multilingual." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:tools a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "tools" ;
    skos:definition "All Tool records in the index." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:tools_provided a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "tools_provided" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Tool ;
    skos:definition "Tools this facility maintains or gives access to (by id). Use for hosted instances and lab-maintained software, not for every tool staff members happen to use." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:training_materials a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "training_materials" ;
    skos:definition "All TrainingMaterial records in the index, including tutorials, lessons and other didactic resources." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:uses_datasets a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "uses_datasets" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Dataset ;
    skos:definition "Existing datasets used as research inputs by the containing project (by IDHI URN). Use for source or reference data consumed by the project, not datasets produced by it, which belong in outputs_datasets." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:uses_services a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "uses_services" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Service ;
    skos:definition "Services used by the containing project (by IDHI URN). Use for externally or institutionally delivered services that support the work, not services produced as project outputs." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:uses_tools a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "uses_tools" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Tool ;
    skos:definition "Tools used to conduct the containing project (by IDHI URN). Use for substantive research or technical dependencies, not tools produced by the project, which belong in outputs_tools." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:Affiliation a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Affiliation" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:organization ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Organization ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:organization ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:affiliation_role ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:affiliation_role ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:organization ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:PersonOrgRoleEnum ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:affiliation_role ],
        idhi:Relationship ;
    skos:definition "A person's employment or membership at an organization, nested in a Person so the member is inferred from the containing record. Use in Person.affiliations for the person's institutional home(s), independent of any project; do not provide the containing person's ID in the relationship." ;
    skos:exactMatch cerif:Person_OrganisationUnit ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

        [ a owl:Restriction ;

            owl:onProperty idhi:author_order ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;

        [ a owl:Restriction ;
