    skos:definition "Total size of the described dataset distribution in bytes. Use an exact or documented aggregate byte count and omit it when only an unreliable estimate is available." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:code_repository a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "code_repository" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "Source-code repository URL (GitHub, GitLab...), if open." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:contributor a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "contributor" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Agent ;
    skos:definition "The person or organization contributing to the containing Tool or Dataset (by IDHI URN). Use only in resource_contributions; do not duplicate the relationship on the Agent." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:dataset_type a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "dataset_type" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:DatasetTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "The dataset's primary intellectual or collection form. Use this for discovery categories such as digital edition, corpus or gazetteer; use media_type for its technical serialization." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:distribution_url a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "distribution_url" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "Direct download or access URL for the dataset." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:event_agent a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "event_agent" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Agent ;
    skos:definition "The person or organization involved in the containing event (by IDHI URN). Use only in Event.event_agent_roles; do not duplicate the relationship on the Agent." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:event_agent_role a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "event_agent_role" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:EventAgentRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "The capacity in which the agent is involved in the containing event. Choose the most specific applicable role and create separate relationships when the same agent has multiple roles." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:event_type a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "event_type" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:EventTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "The kind of scholarly event." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:facility_affiliation_role a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "facility_affiliation_role" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:FacilityAffiliationRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "The organization's relationship to the containing facility. Use HOST when it provides the facility's institutional or operational home and OWNER when it legally or administratively owns the facility; create two relationships when distinct organizations fill those roles." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:funding_amount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "funding_amount" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:float ;
    skos:definition "Amount awarded by the funding organization, if public, in the currency given by funding_currency, or ILS when no currency is recorded. Omit rather than guess." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:funding_currency a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "funding_currency" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:CurrencyEnum ;
    skos:definition "Currency of funding_amount. Record it whenever the amount is present and the currency is known; omit it when no amount is recorded." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:funding_organization a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "funding_organization" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Organization ;
    skos:definition "The organization that provides this funding award (by IDHI URN)." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:funding_status a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "funding_status" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:FundingStatusEnum ;
    skos:definition "The project's current primary funding or sustainability status at the time the record is maintained. Use this for present support, while funding records preserve past and current award history; update it when the project's circumstances change. This uses an IDHI-specific property because established vocabularies do not provide a controlled current-sustainability status for projects." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:funding_url a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "funding_url" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "Public landing page for the individual award or its authoritative funding record. Use the funding organization's homepage on the Organization record instead when no award-specific page exists." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:grant_number a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "grant_number" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:definition "Identifier assigned to the grant by its funding organization. Use the funder's exact value and omit it when none is published." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:homepage a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "homepage" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "Public landing page of the entity, if one exists." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:image a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "image" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:base64Binary ;
    skos:definition "A representative image embedded as Base64-encoded binary content. Use for a single image that must travel with the entity record; omit it when no image is available, and use homepage or additional_urls for externally hosted pages rather than encoding a URL here." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:language a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "language" ;
    rdfs:range [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
            owl:intersectionOf ( xsd:string [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
                        owl:onDatatype xsd:string ;
                        owl:withRestrictions ( [ xsd:pattern "^[A-Za-z]{1,8}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$" ] ) ] ) ] ;
    skos:definition "BCP-47 language tag of the value, such as en, he, ar, de, yi or lad. Use the shortest registered tag that accurately identifies the text; the deliberately permissive syntax guard accepts private and grandfathered tags and does not verify registration in the IANA language-subtag registry." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:marketplace_sync a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "marketplace_sync" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:boolean ;
    skos:definition "Opt-in flag for synchronization with the DARIAH SSH Open Marketplace. Set true to allow the organization and entities related to it through IDHI references, such as services and tools, to be synchronized; false or omission means they must not be synchronized on this organization's authority. This operational flag does not assert ownership of related entities. It uses an IDHI-specific property because established descriptive vocabularies do not provide a term for this synchronization policy." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:material_url a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "material_url" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "Direct landing or access URL for the instructional resource. Use homepage for a broader site about the material and material_url for the resource learners open." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:orcid a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "orcid" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "The person's persistent researcher identifier. It supplements the IDHI record id. Strongly recommended for every researcher; enables deduplication and linking to the scholarly record." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:org_project_role a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "org_project_role" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:OrgProjectRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "The organization's function in the project: COORDINATOR leads the consortium, PARTNER contributes work, DATA_PROVIDER supplies source data, FUNDER records funding when no distinct award can be described, and HOST provides the institutional home. Create one relationship instance per role, and do not duplicate an award already represented in funding." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:organization_type a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "organization_type" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:OrganizationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "The kind of organization. Always set it." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:parent_organization a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "parent_organization" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Organization ;
    skos:definition "The larger organization containing the current child organization (by IDHI URN). Use only in Organization.organization_structure; define the relationship on the child rather than the parent." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:part_of a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "part_of" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "The containing work (book for a chapter, proceedings for a paper), by IDHI URN or external URI." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:part_of_training_material a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "part_of_training_material" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:TrainingMaterial ;
    skos:definition "The larger training material of which this resource is a module or lesson (by IDHI URN). Use only for formal instructional containment, not loose topical similarity." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:participant a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "participant" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Person ;
    skos:definition "The person taking part in the containing project (by IDHI URN). Use in Project.project_participations; do not define the relationship on the Person." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:participation_role a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "participation_role" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:ProjectRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "The person's function within the project team. Use PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR only for the formally designated PI(s); DH_LEAD for digital method and architecture, TECHNICAL_LEAD for ownership of software engineering, DEVELOPER for implementation, CONSULTANT for bounded external professional work, RESEARCHER for scholarly research, STUDENT for enrolled students, ADVISOR for mentorship, and CONTRIBUTOR only when none of the specific values fits." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:programming_language a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "programming_language" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:definition "Main implementation language, as a single technical label such as Python. Do not use this slot for natural languages supported by the tool." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:provider a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "provider" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Organization ;
    skos:definition "The organization formally responsible for delivering the service (the one you'd contact or contract with) — set this even when the service is listed under a Facility." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:publication_type a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "publication_type" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "The kind of publication (journal article, book part, conference paper, thesis...). Pick the most specific applicable value." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:resource_contribution_role a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "resource_contribution_role" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:ResourceContributionRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "The contributor's responsibility for the containing Tool or Dataset. Choose the most specific applicable role and create separate relationships when one contributor has materially distinct responsibilities." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:ror a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "ror" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
    skos:definition "The organization's persistent registry identifier. It supplements the IDHI record id. Record it whenever the organization is registered in ROR — most universities and research institutes are." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:service_type a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "service_type" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:ToolServiceTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "The kind of service offered (digitization, consulting...)." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:tool_type a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "tool_type" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:ToolServiceTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "The delivery form of the tool (web app, library, CLI...). Pick the single value describing how users primarily consume it." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:training_material_type a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "training_material_type" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:TrainingMaterialTypeEnum ;
    skos:definition "The material's primary didactic form. Choose the single value that best describes how learners engage with it, not its file format." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:value a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "value" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:definition "A localized text, in the language given by 'language'." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:Event a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Event" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:event_agent_roles ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:event_type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:LangString ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:address ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:contact_email ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:location ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:date ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:end_date ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:LangString ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:location ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:anyURI ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:additional_urls ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
                    owl:onDatatype xsd:string ;
                    owl:withRestrictions ( [ xsd:pattern "idhi:Event" ] ) ] ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:string ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:contact_email ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:id ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:end_date ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:string ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:id ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:event_type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:LangString ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:name ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:name ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:end_date ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:EventAgentRole ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:event_agent_roles ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:additional_urls ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:start_date ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:contact_email ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:EventTypeEnum ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:event_type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:id ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:start_date ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:address ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:date ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:start_date ],
        idhi:Entity ;
    skos:definition "A scholarly event: conference, workshop, seminar, lecture, hackathon or exhibition. Use Event for time-bounded gatherings; recurring series should be modeled as one Event per occurrence." ;
    skos:exactMatch schema1:Event ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:FacilityAffiliationRoleEnum a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "FacilityAffiliationRoleEnum" ;
    owl:unionOf ( <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/FacilityAffiliationRoleEnum#HOST> schema1:owns ) ;
    skos:definition "IDHI-governed roles distinguishing the organizations connected to a facility. Use one relationship per organization and role so hosting and ownership are not conflated." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi ;
    linkml:permissible_values schema1:owns,
        <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/FacilityAffiliationRoleEnum#HOST> .

idhi:ResourceContribution a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "ResourceContribution" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:resource_contribution_role ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:ResourceContributionRoleEnum ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:resource_contribution_role ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:contributor ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:contributor ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:resource_contribution_role ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Agent ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:contributor ],
        idhi:Relationship ;
    skos:definition "A person or organization contributing to the containing Tool or Dataset in a defined capacity, with optional dates for time-bounded responsibility. Use in Tool.resource_contributions or Dataset.resource_contributions for creation, software development, maintenance, data curation or other named contributions; use publisher where supported for formal publication responsibility and Project.project_participations for project-level work." ;
    skos:exactMatch schema1:Role ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:datasets a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "datasets" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:Dataset ;
    skos:definition "All Dataset records in the index, including digital archives and catalogs.",
        "Datasets aggregated by a Dataset that functions as a catalog (by id)." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:in_languages a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "in_languages" ;
    rdfs:range [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
            owl:intersectionOf ( xsd:string [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
                        owl:onDatatype xsd:string ;
                        owl:withRestrictions ( [ xsd:pattern "^[A-Za-z]{1,8}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$" ] ) ] ) ] ;
    skos:definition "Languages substantially represented in a dataset or in which instructional content is available, using BCP-47 tags. For training material, record every complete language version and do not include a language used only in captions or examples; for datasets, record the languages of the data rather than its metadata page." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:resource_contributions a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "resource_contributions" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:ResourceContribution ;
    skos:definition "Named contributions to the containing Tool or Dataset, with contributor, role and optional dates. Define each contribution only on the resource; use publisher where supported for the organization formally releasing it and Project.project_participations for work described only at project level." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

<https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/software/> a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "DEVELOPER",
        "TECHNICAL_LEAD" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:ProjectRoleEnum,
        idhi:ResourceContributionRoleEnum ;
    skos:definition "A team member implementing the project's software under their own or another person's technical direction; use TECHNICAL_LEAD when they own the engineering architecture and maintenance.",
        "Designs or implements software in a Tool; do not use for dataset curation or for project-level participation without a specific resource contribution.",
        "Owns or directs the project's software engineering and technical maintenance. Use this when responsibility exceeds implementation by a DEVELOPER; use DH_LEAD instead for leadership of the scholarly digital method or data model." .

idhi:CurrencyEnum a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "CurrencyEnum" ;
    owl:unionOf ( <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q131309> <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4917> <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4916> ) ;
    skos:definition "Currencies in which a funding award amount may be expressed, as ISO 4217 codes. The list covers the currencies relevant to IDHI records; extend it before recording an award in another currency." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi ;
    linkml:permissible_values <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q131309>,
        <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4916>,
        <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q4917> .

idhi:media_type a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "media_type" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:definition "Technical media type of the primary dataset distribution or training resource, preferably an IANA media type such as text/html, application/pdf, application/vnd.apache.parquet or video/mp4. Dataset records may list multiple formats; do not use this for an intellectual or didactic form, which belongs in dataset_type or training_material_type." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:AuthorshipRoleEnum a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "AuthorshipRoleEnum" ;
    owl:unionOf ( <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#AUTHOR> <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#EDITOR> <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#TRANSLATOR> <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#CONTRIBUTOR> ) ;
    skos:definition "The kind of contribution to a publication." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi ;
    linkml:permissible_values <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#AUTHOR>,
        <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#CONTRIBUTOR>,
        <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#EDITOR>,
        <https://idhi_placeholder/linkml/AuthorshipRoleEnum#TRANSLATOR> .

idhi:Person a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Person" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:LangString ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:given_name ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:string ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:emails ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:anyURI ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:orcid ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:orcid ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:id ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:affiliations ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:id ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:string ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:id ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:orcid ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:LangString ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:family_name ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
                    owl:onDatatype xsd:string ;
                    owl:withRestrictions ( [ xsd:pattern "idhi:Person" ] ) ] ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:given_name ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Affiliation ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:affiliations ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:family_name ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:emails ],
        idhi:Agent ;
    skos:definition "A human agent in the DH index: researcher, developer, librarian, student, etc." ;
    skos:exactMatch foaf:Person ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:Publication a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Publication" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:published_in ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:date ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:date_issued ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:date_issued ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:string ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:id ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:name ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:anyURI ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:part_of ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Event ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:presented_at ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:Authorship ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:authorships ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:date_issued ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:publication_type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:part_of ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:publication_type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:PublicationTypeEnum ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:publication_type ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom idhi:LangString ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:published_in ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:anyURI ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:doi ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 0 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:presented_at ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
                    owl:onDatatype xsd:string ;

idhi:name a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "name" ;
    rdfs:range idhi:LangString ;

Prefer the official localized name for organizations; for projects, tools and services, use localized names supplied by the team rather than translating branded names without authority." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:contact_email a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "contact_email" ;
    skos:definition "A published contact address for the entity (office, team or service-desk mailbox). For a person's own addresses use 'emails'." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:id a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "id" ;
    rdfs:range [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
            owl:intersectionOf ( xsd:string [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
                        owl:onDatatype xsd:string ;
                        owl:withRestrictions ( [ xsd:pattern "^idhi:[a-z_]+:[0-9a-z]{4,12}$" ] ) ] ) ] ;
    skos:definition """The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form
  idhi:<class name>:<random short alphanumeric id>
e.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1. Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed. The class token is the lowercase snake_case class name; each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage. External identifiers (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots — never here.""" ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:type a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "type" ;
    rdfs:range xsd:string ;
    skos:definition "Discriminator identifying the record's class; used for polymorphic serialization and deserialization." ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

    rdfs:label "LangString" ;

            owl:allValuesFrom [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
                    owl:intersectionOf ( xsd:string [ a rdfs:Datatype ;
                                owl:onDatatype xsd:string ;
                                owl:withRestrictions ( [ xsd:pattern "^[A-Za-z]{1,8}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$" ] ) ] ) ] ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:language ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:language ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:value ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:maxCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:language ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:allValuesFrom xsd:string ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:value ],
        [ a owl:Restriction ;
            owl:minCardinality 1 ;
            owl:onProperty idhi:value ] ;
    skos:definition "A single language-tagged text value. Instances are combined in a multivalued slot to give variants of one field in any language identified by a BCP-47 tag. Use one LangString per language; do not repeat a language within the same field." ;
    skos:exactMatch rdf:langString ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

items.text: Primary first-class entities in the IDHI index — those that carry their own IDHI URN and are listed directly in IndexContainer.

items.title: Base64binary
items.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: Base64binary

Binary content represented as a Base64-encoded string. Use for embedded bytes when a separate file or URL is not appropriate; do not include a data-URI prefix.

items.title: Boolean
items.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: Boolean

A binary (true or false) value

items.text:

a compact URI

items.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: DateOrDatetime

Either a date or a datetime

items.title: Datetime
items.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: Datetime

items.title: Jsonpath
items.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: Jsonpath

A string encoding a JSON Path. The value of the string MUST conform to JSON Point syntax and SHOULD dereference to zero or more valid objects within the current instance document when encoded in tree form.

items.title: Jsonpointer
items.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: Jsonpointer

A string encoding a JSON Pointer. The value of the string MUST conform to JSON Point syntax and SHOULD dereference to a valid object within the current instance document when encoded in tree form.

items.title: Objectidentifier
items.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: Objectidentifier

A URI or CURIE that represents an object in the model.

items.title: Sparqlpath
